Augury.title: Sales Application Engineer United States (Remote)
Augury.description: Application Engineer | Augury About The Position As an Application Engineer, you will visit our customers or prospective customers in person to generate a Scope Of Work (SOW) by observing rotating equipment, reviewing engineering documents, engineering key Augury hardware or software applications, and helping develop the value of condition monitoring. A Day In Your Life Plan and execute site visits with customers; professionally represent Augury in the field. Work closely with Augury Sales and Engineering teams to drive SOW creation at customer sites. Walk through facilities to observe rotating machines, and design the application of hardware and software solutions to meet the needs of our customers. Write site visit reports. Manage the handoff of SOW to Sales and Implementation/Installation teams via internal tools. Effectively manage time and administrative tasks, which include, but are not limited to, service reports, customer action lists, asset lists, Salesforce, and other project management software. Train to sharpen your skillset and capabilities: Learn and research different aspects of manufacturing industries, condition monitoring technologies, reliability techniques, and maintenance, also different machines and manufacturing operations. This job requires up to 90% travel to visit sites for scope generation. What You Bring Experience: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (preferably Chemical, Mechanical, or equivalent) or 5 years of experience working in manufacturing in Operations, Maintenance, or Reliability. Desire to work and learn in a fast paced environment. Drive: A love of cutting-edge technology, industrial businesses, and can think on your feet. You are looking for an opportunity to join a company that is changing the manufacturing industry. Superb communication skills: You love interacting live with customers and have the ability to lead technical discovery discussions at the site level of an organization. Craft questions for customers to identify the best scope of work, implementation technique, and intersect application selection with value for the customer’s organization. Must have a valid driver's license, passport, and the ability to successfully pass a background check. Residence in the US, ideally within one hour of a major airport. Able to travel internationally when required. Vibration Analyst Category I or II certification is a plus. Experience working in industrial environments is a plus. Professional presence and ability to represent Augury in the field. We offer several perks that include flexible PTO, medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k) match, stock options, paid parental leave, and WFH and phone stipend. The pay range for this position in Colorado, California, and New York is a base salary of $75,000 - $95,000 This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. The pay offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, and experience. After you apply, you may be invited to complete a short, asynchronous interview with June, our AI Recruitment Agent as the first step in our process. You can complete it whenever it works best for your schedule—no need to wait for a recruiter to book time with you. Booking.com.title: Learn about hybrid work
Booking.com.description: Hybrid Way of Working | Booking.com Careers Skip To Main Content Our Hybrid Way of Working Hybrid ways of working provide a balance of working in the office and at home. We believe in the power of connecting with each other in person as well as being able to plan focus time working at home. Whether in the office or at home, we aim to empower you to do your best work. We are not a remote working company, but we are flexible. Our hybrid way of working policy is designed for both the individual need for flexibility and the collective need for a strong community and culture. Support and benefits as Booking.com employees Working from home We support our employees with the set-up of their home office - from ergonomic furniture to all the necessary IT equipment including provisions for specific individual needs. Office perks We offer benefits for lunch and game rooms in some of our locations. Read More Wellness Our employee journeys are supported with a variety of wellbeing materials including an employee assistance portal and an employee resource group to help maintain a flexible work-life balance. Read More What does hybrid working mean at Booking.com? We know there’s no one-size-fits-all approach for how teams and individuals collaborate. To balance personal flexibility with the benefit that comes with being physically together, we encourage colleagues to spend at least 40% of their time in person with their team to contribute to the culture and experience we are trying to build. You’ll make team agreements when you’ll connect together in the office. Some exceptions may apply based on the critical nature of the role. How we work Virtual interview For most of our offices around the world, interviews take place online. After you’ve applied for a position, one of our recruiters will take your application into consideration and determine if you may fit the role. If there’s a potential match, we’ll send you an invite to join a first video interview where we’ll better get to know each other and learn more about your career goals. Don’t worry, when the time comes, we’ll provide you with detailed instructions on how to set up your online interview. Relocating If you’ve accepted an offer with a relocation package, our dedicated team of experts will help you move and find your way around the city. Our offices are located in some of the world’s most vibrant, welcoming and diverse tech hubs and we’ll do our best to make you feel at home, as quickly as possible. Virtual onboarding We have found an innovative way to onboard our new colleagues in our locations all over the world. We’ve developed a virtual onboarding process that consists of a virtual onboarding group, online learnings and virtual meetings with your new team. Our dedicated team of onboarding and IT experts will ensure everything is set up properly, so you can focus on what you do best. Working together You could be virtually meeting, chatting and collaborating together with diverse colleagues from all over the world or connecting in one of our breakout rooms in our collaborative office spaces. Building work friendships becomes a whole new experience as we’ll provide you with access to some of the world’s most innovative tools for online communication. Whether you’re having a virtual coffee with your manager or presenting your work to teams in the office in Amsterdam or Tel Aviv, you’ll easily become part of the Booking.com family. Frequently asked questions Everything you need to know about our Hybrid Way of Working approach. How often can you work from home and how often must you be in the office? We recognize the benefits of flexibility for focus, wellbeing, caregiving responsibility and the different ways our team works. To ensure consistent in-person collaboration, we encourage you to spend 40% of your working time in the office. Team members and their managers agree on the schedule, including regular team days, so colleagues can reliably see each other in person. When you aren’t in the office, are there any core hours that you have to be online? According to our Employee Handbook, core working hours are between the hours of 10am and 4pm. Exceptions can be discussed with the manager and HR depending on individual needs. Can you work from home 100% of the time? At Booking.com, our offices are a special part of our DNA and we have never been a fully remote company. Face to face connection and collaboration play an important role in our culture. While Booking.com has a hybrid approach, we want to encourage you to come to the office when it works best for you and the team. Therefore we implemented team agreements to facilitate this. Can you work from a location other than your home or office? An employee’s place of work will continue to be their assigned Booking.com office, unless otherwise agreed. Additionally, the employee’s main work from home location must be within a commuting distance of their assigned Booking.com office. In addition to the above, our Working from Abroad policy allows for working from a different country for up to 20 days per calendar year as long as your request meets the conditions of the policy (e.g. legal right to work in a country & no tax or social security consequences for you or the company). From FinTech to Accommodations, coding to customer service, when you love what you do and the people you work with, amazing things can happen. Read more about our business units below. Business Units Accommodations Trips FinTech Legal and Public Affairs Marketing People Technology Finance Marketplace Accommodations With 28 million listings on our platform, it’s no surprise that Accommodations is at the core of our business. This business unit brings together teams from product development, technology, partner services and customer service to create a stellar user experience that seamlessly unites supply and demand. This vital cross-functional engine also works across Booking Holdings brands, helping drive growth in US markets and supporting the partners who list their properties on our platform with industry news, advice and opportunities to grow their businesses. See jobs Trips The Trips business unit is responsible for ‘Everything But The Stay’. Cars, Rides, Flights, Attractions, and Insurance – Trips has it all covered. They’re bringing to life our vision for building the connected trip, providing customers with a seamless and frictionless customer experience throughout their journey. When you’re ready to rent a car, summon a ride, or book an attraction, Trips helps you do what you want to do, while making it easy to get around once you get there. See jobs FinTech Our FinTech business unit – with teams in Amsterdam, London and Shanghai – develops new products and drives innovation to help us continue removing financial friction from the travel process. That makes buying and selling travel-related products and services simpler for both travellers and partners across the globe. In addition to aggregating smart integrations to connect to payment providers and platforms around the world, our team is continuing to increase wallet functionality within the Booking.com platform, innovating customer flexibility and mitigating risks. See jobs Legal and Public Affairs We conduct business across several countries, regions and jurisdictions. They work together in lock step to bring great deals to customers and help our partners outperform the competition. We want every one of our employees to be proud to work alongside us and feel supported in the growth of their careers. Indeed, our success depends on it. See jobs Technology This business unit builds, maintains and continuously improves our technological foundation, which touches every single aspect of our business. These teams work together to ensure we collect data responsibly, use it effectively, and stay on top of the latest trends and techniques. From ensuring robust user privacy practices to growing machine learning innovations to making sure every device that connects us is 100% cybersecure, this business unit takes on a lot of responsibility. See jobs Finance Making sure everyone gets paid is just the start for our Finance business unit. Among other things, they handle quarterly earnings reports, cash management, budgeting, procurements, forecasting and tax located around the globe. As the world becomes increasingly more digitised, the role of big data and analytics becomes ever more important to how we run our business – and the role and influence of our Finance team grows. From browsing to booking and beyond, our focus is on building the connected experiences which make journeys smoother, faster and more enjoyable. How to master the virtual interview Prepare for your virtual interview and boost your confidence with our tips Your interview process Application Our careers site is designed to support our candidates to find the best suitable opportunity we have available at any given time. Bookaway.title: About us
Bookaway.description: About Us | Bookaway Experience the liberation of travel Founded by travelers for travelers, Bookaway is an online ground transportation booking platform that takes the stress out of travel so you can enjoy the ride. We’re all about the journey We’re a new generation of travelers who expect everything to be a screen tap away, including bus, ferry and train tickets to the world’s best locations. Today’s travelers want to explore the world with confidence. From language barriers, local currency and anxiety over the unknown, traveling can be stressful. Rely on Bookaway for 24/7 support, honest reviews and accurate information about every ride. Bookaway is more than getting from one place to another, it’s about the journey. Enjoy the ride. Our journey began with a single ride​​ Way back in 2016 a traveler just like you was honeymooning in the Philippines and wanted to get from Manila to Banaue to see the magnificent rice terraces. This is where the story gets complicated, but has a cool twist at the end, so stay tuned. Our traveler, let’s call him Noam, could not find available bus tickets and had to wait two days until the next available tickets could be purchased. Thinking “there must be a better way to book ground transportation,” the idea of Bookaway was born. We know what you think “how is this not a thing yet? Well, we’re happy to say that now it is. You can find us everywhere We love our travelers and they love us back 113 + reviews Take a look at our numbers With headquarters in Bangkok and Tel Aviv, we pride ourselves on working with local operators and global partners. +500K Travelers +26K Travel routes +128 Countries +2.2K Local operators +1.2K Digital partners And we're constantly growing Become an operator Become an affiliate Welcome to Bookaway. We have a ride for any journey. ​ Join us, it’s going to be a good one. By comparing schedules and BIM against site reality, its advanced AI transforms granular data into insights that unlock operational excellence. Fortune 500 contractors and owners trust Buildots, including HOCHTIEF, Bouygues, Intel, NCC and VINCI Construction. Its impact is proven at every scale, from multi-family projects to multi-gigawatt data centers. Role Overview The Business Process Manager is responsible for orchestrating strategic projects and operational infrastructure within the Buildots Customer Office . Acting as the engine of the department, this is a unique ‘thinker-doer’ role that connects high-level strategy to the data-driven realities of our daily operations. We are looking for a hybrid, process-oriented professional, part Strategic PMO and part Business Operations strategist , to design and lead the initiatives that empower our Customer Success and Delivery teams. This is an internal-facing position, not a customer-facing role. It is designed for a professional who thrives on turning complex operational friction into streamlined, repeatable, and scalable workflows. Your mission is to improve how we deliver, support, and scale world-class customer experiences. You will ensure our service standards are codified, measurable, and consistently exceeded as we grow. Key Responsibilities Strategic Initiative Execution: Take full ownership of the end-to-end delivery of key initiatives within the Customer Office. You will drive complex and diverse projects—such as new service delivery models or cross-departmental technical integrations—with precision and speed. Internal Consulting & Discovery: Act as an internal consultant by independently conducting research on new concepts and technical subject matter. You will perform root-cause analysis on operational friction points to propose "best-in-class" solutions. Business Impact Tracking: Define and track success metrics for specific initiatives, correlating internal process improvements to external customer outcomes (e.g., reduction in churn or increased speed-to-value). Change Execution: Lead the "internal launch" of new processes or tools, ensuring clear communication, documentation, and high adoption rates across all affected teams. Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identify "blind spots" between departments, managing dependencies to ensure that internal technical shifts don't disrupt the customer experience. Operational Visibility: Define and monitor KPIs. You will build and maintain the dashboards that provide the visibility and accountability necessary for data-driven decision-making. Requirements Strategic PMO Experience: 5+ years in Strategic Project Management, PMO, Business Operations or Strategy & Operations, ideally in dynamic, fast-paced, global environments (B2B SaaS preferred). GTM Operational Background: Proven experience working directly with Go-To-Market teams (Sales/CS) and Operational functions. You understand the mechanics of the customer lifecycle. Influence & Communication: Exceptional skills in aligning stakeholders. You are a natural collaborator who leads through influence, explaining complex changes in a way that gets people on board. Execution Excellence: A "builder" mindset with a record of taking messy, high-level strategic goals and turning them into structured, executable programs. Independent Researcher: A self-starter who can master new subject matter, technical concepts, or industry standards required to move a project forward. Performance Metrics: Hands-on experience with defining, tracking, and reporting on KPIs and company-wide initiatives. Data-Driven Mindset: Proficiency in using data to track project success and identify where operational gaps impact the customer experience. Proficient in tools like Excel, Google Sheets, Salesforce, project management software (e.g., Asana, Jira), and BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). Languages: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Hebrew. It’s also a Plus If You Have experience in the Construction Tech industry. Job Title Sr. Technician Role Overview Hands‑on production technician responsible for high‑reliability electronics assembly on Aitech rugged products and boards. The role covers precision soldering, press‑fit connector installation, conformal coating & masking, potting, and mechanical assembly under Class‑3 workmanship and aerospace quality requirements (IPC‑A‑610 / J‑STD‑001; ESD discipline; FOD control). Qualification Diploma in Electronics/Electrical or Mechatronics. Ability to read assembly drawings, schematics, BoMs, and work instructions (WI/SOPs); familiar with route cards and production travellers. Basic computer use for ERP/MIS data entry; exposure to SAP/ERP preferred. Strong discipline in ESD and safety practices; comfortable with microscopes, fixtures, presses, ovens, curing equipment, torque tools, and measurement instruments. At least 7-8 years’ direct experience in soldering, conformal coating & Assembly. Skills/Experience : · Soldering (through‑hole & fine‑pitch SMT rework) to IPC‑A‑610 Class‑3 workmanship and J‑STD‑001 process controls; enforce FOD controls in all operations. IPC-7711/21 certified will be preferred. · Press‑fit connector installation using qualified press, bottom & flat top tools, alignment checks, and post‑press inspection; maintain tool validation and apply X‑ray verification where required; update route card after each operation. · Conformal coating execution, including masking of keep‑out zones and defect prevention; ability to work with QA on SCAR/CAR closures when needed. · Masking proficiency (tapes, boots, liquid masks) with clean edges, proper cure, and removal techniques to avoid residue/under‑mask defects. · Potting & encapsulation : resin prep, degassing, controlled dispense, cure profiles, and void‑free results per WI/SOP; adherence to J‑STD‑001 cleaning requirements. · Mechanical assembly of boards/enclosures (fasteners, torque, thermal interfaces, staking) per conduction‑cooled enclosures · In‑process & final inspection : visual criteria, continuity/shorts checks, dimensional verification, and documentation sign‑offs per QA instructions. · ESD discipline, cleanroom/controlled environment behaviour, and recordkeeping (lot/serial traceability, traveller signatures, tool calibration records). · Proven experience as team player within a multi-site environment · Understanding of safety and equipment procedures. · Extensive knowledge of aerospace materials, components, and equipment, including their handling, storage, and transportation requirements. · Proficiency in production related activities SAP/ERP systems, and data analytics tools. · Manufacturing Process : Understanding of Manufacturing Processes, Manufacturing Time Study, Process Optimization. · Reporting : Compiling management reports on overall plant performance, and preparing MIS reports · Quality control : Awareness of ISO:9001-2015 – Mandatory, AS9100D - Nice to have. · Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with stakeholders at all levels. Desired Skills : · AS9100D awareness; ISO 9001:2015 quality mindset. · Experience with thermal pads/Paste, CTQs, and following customer assembly drawings (top/bottom, conformal coating maps). · Exposure to environmental testing (vibration, shock, TVAC, humidity) and ATE handling/debugging. · Familiarity with mechanical metrology, torque/angle tools, and fixture setup for precision press‑fit operations. · Time management skills to handle multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet tight deadlines. Roles and Responsibilities: 1. Execute production tasks (soldering, press‑fit, coating/masking, potting, mechanical assembly) strictly per Aitech WI/SOPs and customer drawings; comply with IPC‑A‑610 Class‑3 and J‑STD‑001 requirements. 2. Press‑fit operations : Verify tooling alignment, apply controlled force, perform post‑press inspection/X‑ray as specified, and record route card updates for each step. 3. Conformal coating & masking : Ensure accurate masking of keep‑out areas, defect‑free application, and participate in SCAR/CAR investigations with QA when defects are detected. 4. Potting/encapsulation : Prepare materials, control mix ratios/cure, conduct post‑cure cleanliness to meet J‑STD‑001 acceptance; document batch/lot details. 5. Mechanical assembly : Install hardware and thermal interfaces, apply specified torque, and verify fit/form/function; complete final inspection records. 6. ESD & FOD control : Maintain compliance with SOW requirements for FOD prevention, cleaning, and post‑process residue checks—no ultrasonic cleaning; meet specified cleanliness limits. 7. Quality documentation & traceability : Ensure traveller/route card completeness, calibration stickers are current, and first‑off/in‑process/final inspections are signed by QC. 8. Cross‑functional collaboration : work with QA, PPC, and Manufacturing to resolve production issues, support continuous improvement, and contribute to MIS/ERP updates as required. 9. Training & compliance : maintain skill certification (e.g., IPC‑A‑610 CIS/CIT where applicable) and participate in periodic special‑process validations (pins pressing, isolation removal, sleeving). Apply for this position

Bluevine.title: Grace D. Timberdoodle
Bluevine.description: How Timberdoodle upgraded its business banking with Bluevine | Bluevine Skip to content How Timberdoodle upgraded its business banking with Bluevine Ryan Hussey September 10, 2024 3 min read SHARE: Running a business involves a lot of exactly that— running around. With so many tasks on your to-do list and only so many hours in the day, it’s important to find ways to be more efficient. Your business banking platform should help with that efficiency and make it easier to manage your money on your terms. Grace Deffinbaugh is the busy Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Timberdoodle Co. , a family-owned business founded in 1985 by her parents, Dan and Deb. Since then, Timberdoodle has grown from a self-described “humble back-porch venture” into a multi-warehouse online curator of homeschooling resources. According to a Washington Post article from 2023 , homeschooling is the fastest-growing form of education in the United States. Timberdoodle was ahead of the trend, providing sought-after homeschooling materials to parents before they were readily available. Now, with more options than ever, the company’s focus has shifted to curating the best of the best—selling full curriculum kits and customizable packages to both parents and charter schools. The problem “When my dad retired,” Grace explains, “the business had some extra cash sitting, and we wanted to earn interest on it.” On top of that, Grace realized she was spending too much time physically driving to a local credit union to deposit checks and handle basic banking tasks. Unfortunately, the credit union didn’t offer the digital banking tools or high interest rate the Timberdoodle team needed to make the most of their time and money. Since Grace is also a foster mom on the side, it’s crucial that she’s able to do her job from the office, at home, and when she’s on the move. An easy-to-use online banking platform was the missing piece—and if she could find a checking account that helped maximize her interest earnings, she would make the switch in a heartbeat. Check out the video below to see how Grace and Timberdoodle upgraded their business banking by switching to Bluevine. The solution Changing your business checking account can be scary, but Grace knew it was time to find a banking solution that worked. So, she searched through many online banking options, including traditional banks and fintechs, before deciding on Bluevine. “Since switching to Bluevine, we’ve saved countless hours…” Grace says. “Onboarding was phenomenally easy. Mobile deposits are so easy to do, and online banking is so streamlined.” Now, with convenient mobile deposits, Grace can deposit checks from her phone instead of traveling to and from a physical branch. She can also connect her Bluevine Business Checking account to QuickBooks Online ® and sync bills, transactions, and payees. BVSUP-00056 “I can bring my phone with me and access the Bluevine app. I don’t have to worry about who I should give access to when I’m out of the office—I can take the office with me.” The time Timberdoodle saves by using Bluevine allows Grace to spend more time with her foster children. She also cites the ability to earn interest as one of her favorite things about the banking platform. BVSUP-00118 “Bluevine offers a high-interest account with higher limits than most banking platforms put on it. I love that sub-accounts also earn interest.” BVSUP-00053 Did you know? Sub-accounts are similar to your main account and help you budget more effectively for growth, payroll, taxes, and emergencies. With the standard plan, you can add up to five sub-accounts. Leveling up their business checking plan With Bluevine, Grace has opted for an upgraded business checking plan called Bluevine Premier . Our Premier plan comes with supercharged benefits for small businesses, including: A higher annual percentage yield (APY) on higher balances BVSUP-00116 Discounts on Standard plan payment fees Priority customer support BVSUP-00119 And more “We are a Bluevine Premier customer because of the higher interest rate it affords us,” Grace says, “and because it allows us to have a higher account balance that we’re still making the interest on…so we can make money off everything we have sitting there.” BVSUP-00116 When asked if there’s one thing she would tell fellow business owners about Bluevine, Grace concludes with: “Everything about Bluevine is well thought through, and they’re making continual advancements to make it better, so we really appreciate that.” Choose a business checking plan that fits your company’s needs. Bluevine.title: With how much time I save now, I don’t know if I could ever go back to a traditional, brick-and-mortar bank.”
Bluevine.description: How FoodDays Simplified Its Business Banking | Bluevine | Bluevine Skip to content How FoodDays simplified business payments with Bluevine Ryan Hussey April 18, 2025 5 min read SHARE: Small business owners are used to wearing many hats. Depending on the size of their team, an owner could be responsible for everything from operations to marketing to IT. On top of that, they still need to manage business finances and make sure bills are paid on time. This was one of the problems a company called FoodDays faced: They wanted to expand their business, and to do that, they needed to simplify their bill payments. How could they manage and pay their bills faster to free up time for vendor relationships and business growth? Empowering schools and local caterers In the business of school lunch programs, saving time means everything. We recently caught up with Michael Thwaite, Co-Founder and ‘Chief Technology Human’ of FoodDays, a business he started with his wife Pamela nearly 20 years ago. FoodDays provides online solutions that help school lunch programs operate efficiently. Back in 2003, Pamela was running lunch programs as part of the Parent Teacher Association (PTA) in their local school district. When she recognized how inefficient it was to coordinate meals on paper, she had the idea to move it online—and it just so happened that her husband Michael was an experienced software developer. “I foolishly said, ‘Sure, I can do that.’ And so it began…” Michael remembers. This was the start of their small business journey, building software that helps schools without cafeterias successfully run lunch programs. Fast-forward almost 20 years, and the couple has quit their day jobs to focus on expansion. Michael and Pamela work primarily with local vendors to provide meals, directly supporting small businesses that may not have the time to focus on their finances. “On our platform, we can see who bought what, so we’re creating invoices for these small businesses, processing them, and sending them a payment ourselves. We tell vendors, ‘Let us handle the finances and invoices.’ And that allows them to do what they do best: prepare quality food.” By simplifying and digitizing the order process, FoodDays helps PTAs, PTOs, and schools make the most of their budgets. Did you know? Bluevine offers three business checking plans to choose from , each with different levels of features that meet the needs of small businesses at all stages. Simplifying bill pay processes to support growth Efficiency has always been at the heart of FoodDays’ focus. In the process of building their business, Michael began looking for an online bank to increase their company’s efficiency so they could better serve their customers. “In my past experience using traditional banks, I had to move through multiple platforms to make a simple ACH payment,” Michael says. “I wanted an online-only bank because they’re quick and easy.” During his research, Michael came across Bluevine, which he calls “the polar opposite of a traditional bank.” He was looking for an easy-to-use banking dashboard that allowed him to send ACH and check payments, connect to payment processors, and sync with QuickBooks ® Online. BVSUP-00056 “Bluevine’s dashboard is clean and simple, with all the features I need. And I can manage my checking accounts and bills from one place.” Being able to seamlessly manage bill payments and his Bluevine Business Checking account from a single dashboard has saved Michael plenty of time and frustration. “It’s so user-friendly, especially the way my checking account and bill pay work together.” Since opening his first account with Bluevine, Michael has spoken very highly of the Bluevine Customer Support team. “In the early days, I had a couple of questions. I clicked on the chat feature, and my questions were answered within minutes.” Michael adds, “With how much time I save now, I don’t know if I could ever go back to a traditional, brick-and-mortar bank.” Opening a second business checking account with Bluevine Many businesses have primary and secondary checking accounts, sometimes with different institutions. Ultimately, Michael and FoodDays chose to stick with Bluevine for both accounts because of how easy it was to open an account, and how much they loved the simplicity. When Michael and Pamela decided to expand FoodDays and hire additional team members, they also opened another Bluevine checking account under a new business entity. Having a second account allows them to keep finances separate for strategic budgeting. Another way to budget with Bluevine Business Checking is by adding up to five sub-accounts . With designated account numbers, sub-accounts keep budgets separate while allowing small businesses to control exactly which accounts their vendors can bill. BVSUP-00053 Sharing bill pay responsibilities Before finding Bluevine, Michael handled all the bill pay responsibilities for FoodDays. “Vendors often provide the wrong ACH information, so I was sending payments very carefully.” Michael says he’d send test payments of about seven cents to new payees, so he could verify their account before sending the full payment. He’d also update the payment description to ‘pending verification’ to help keep track of statuses. Now, Michael and Pamela have added their team as additional users , giving them access to FoodDays’ second Bluevine account with limited permissions—including submitting bill payments for Michael’s review. This bill approval workflow allows the FoodDays team to set up payments, so all Michael needs to do is double check them and click ‘approve.’ Michael saves time because he doesn’t need to set up the payments himself, plus he gets a convenient email notification when a bill is waiting for his review. And, of course, his payments always have two sets of eyes on them before getting sent out. Growing with confidence With a simplified bill pay platform that works seamlessly with Bluevine Business Checking, FoodDays

Bluevine.title: Learn more about About us
Bluevine.description: About Us | Small Business Banking | Bluevine Skip to content Breaking the barriers of business banking. Our easy-to-use banking platform sets you up for success with the technology and peace of mind you need to do business. Traditional banks have underserved small businesses. We’re here to change that. For too long, small businesses have struggled to access the banking services and support that big companies take for granted. Bluevine was founded over 10 years ago as a financial technology company that builds better banking solutions for growing businesses, and provides the attention and service they deserve. By combining industry-leading technology and security with dependable customer support, we give business owners the funding and services they need to succeed. The Bluevine story. June 2026 Built for millions. Trusted with billions. We crossed 1 million lifetime customers, $2 billion in managed deposits, and $17 billion in loans delivered. A million small business owners chose to build with us, and we’re just getting started. December 2025 Tap to Pay joined our payment options. With Tap to Pay, we made it easy for businesses to accept in-person card and mobile wallet payments instantly using their phones, no extra hardware required. Tap to Pay joins our growing suite of payment features, giving businesses a single place to track all their payments in their Bluevine account. May 2025 We made it even easier to get paid. The addition of invoicing and payment links let customers effortlessly accept multiple payment methods, including credit cards, directly into their Bluevine accounts—making our all-in-one banking platform even more powerful. August 2024 Virtual cards for your team. Bluevine Business Checking customers gained the ability to use virtual debit cards, which allow for immediate use and added flexibility, plus issue physical and virtual cards to their team—all with custom spend controls. April 2024 Multiple checking plans available. By introducing upgraded business checking plans, we helped small businesses get even more for their money. Our Plus and Premier plan options allowed us to offer higher APY, discounted payment fees, and other exclusive features. December 2023 We reached $1B in customer deposits. Our small business customers showed how much they trust our growing suite of business banking tools, and helped us surpass $1 billion in managed deposits for Bluevine Business Checking accounts. August 2023 Celebrating 10 years of Bluevine. To all our customers—building a business from the ground up is something to be proud of. Thank you for joining us on this remarkable journey, yours and ours. Here’s to another ten (or a hundred) more years! April 2023 Our customers could go global with international payments. We invited our customers to join the global community with international payments sent easily from their Bluevine dashboard. January 2023 Jersey City became our new HQ. We moved our office headquarters to Jersey City, NJ, to join a thriving tech community on the East coast. There we expanded our office space to make room for our growing team. July 2022 We built a dashboard for accountants and bookkeepers. Bluevine customers could now invite their accountant or bookkeeper to access their account, making it easier to settle books and collaborate. May 2022 We refreshed our look. Bluevine revealed a powerful new look and feel to better represent our brand, our customers, and our mission—to give small businesses the financial tools they need to succeed. March 2022 We grew to 500+ employees. We celebrated 500 employees across our offices in three countries. February 2022 We launched a better way to pay bills. We brought our customers a streamlined way to pay and manage their business bills with plenty of new bill pay and accounts payable solutions. 2022 Our office footprint expanded (again). New offices joined the fold in Austin, TX and Bengaluru, India. Adding onto our other offices in Jersey City, NJ and Salt Lake City, UT. April 2021 We started (officially) giving back to our communities. Employees participated in our first ever Bluevine Cares volunteer day, working in their local communities in Tel Aviv, Redwood City, Salt Lake City, and Jersey City. August 2020 We launched the Bluevine Business Checking account. With no monthly fees and annual interest above the industry standard, we built an account with the needs of growing businesses in mind. June 2019 We funded $1 Billion in loans! We officially funded our first $1 Billion in loans, giving thousands of small businesses access to the funds they needed to grow. January 2019 We redesigned the Bluevine dashboard. The Bluevine dashboard got an innovative makeover, making it even easier for our customers to access the banking tools they needed. The new dashboard became the launchpad for all our products to come. March 2017 We grew to over 100 employees. Soon after hitting 1,000 customers, our Bluevine employee count also grew—to a solid 100. December 2016 We celebrated our first 1,000 customers. We watched as our Bluevine customer count ticked up from 999 to 1,000. To those first 1,000 customers, thank you—we wouldn’t be here without you. January 2016 Line of Credit joined our product suite. We received our first applications for a Bluevine Line of Credit, a revolving loan built to help small businesses grow. March 2014 We officially launched our first product. Bluevine beta launched invoice factoring. Though we’ve since bid farewell to factoring, it was the beginning of who and what we would become. January 2014 Our first HQ opened in the U.S. We opened our headquarters in the tech capital of the U.S., Silicon Valley, an exciting step for our growing company. August 2013 It all started in 2013. Eyal Lifshitz and Nir Klar founded Bluevine, a fintech company that set out to build a better banking solution for SMBs. Shortly after, our first office opened in Tel Aviv. Awards and recognition. We are continually recognized

To act responsibly within the organization regarding the environment while reducing our environmental impact (energy and water consumption, CO 2 emission, recycling and reducing waste). To combine EHS and energy considerations at every stage of production, from purchasing raw materials through the development of new products, packaging and completion, up to shipment and distribution of the company’s products. To form EHS teams with the required professional knowledge for creating a proactive EHS culture. To supply education and training for all employees in order to improve awareness of EHS and energy aspects. To meet all local legal requirements and Ferring’s global standards regarding EHS and energy. To routinely review EHS and energy performance, conduct incident investigations in order to prevent their reoccurrence, and set goals and objectives for constant improvement. To establish emergency plans in order to ensure business continuity. We are driven by a commitment to not only increase the speed and efficiency of corporate engagements, but to do so in a way that promotes sustainability, inclusiveness, and compliance. We demonstrate these values in our corporate structure and initiatives, and through our client offerings. Frameworks & Assessments We leverage reporting frameworks, such as GHG Protocol and United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), and engage with third-party assessment platforms, including EcoVadis and CDP, to ensure our ESG efforts are measurable and effective. These frameworks and assessments help us integrate ESG strategies into our operations, enhancing our accountability and positioning us as proactive participants in the global sustainability movement. This is reflected in our most recent EcoVadis Silver and SME B CDP ratings. Environment As a streamlined, digital company, Candex is able to strategically limit our use of non-renewable resources and our carbon footprint. Though we operate globally, we limit our office space and travel, leveraging technology and a digital workspace to minimize our carbon footprint. We host the full Candex Platform on cloud-based server space. We proactively identified providers who are focused on leveraging renewable sources of energy and are carbon neutral, with plans to be net-zero in the identifiable future. In addition, our primary server partner powers the cloud servers we use entirely with renewable energy. But sustainability is not just about carbon emissions. It is also about addressing resource depletion, preserving biodiversity, and limiting pollution. Candex was founded with a digital-first philosophy. This extends not only to our SaaS application, but also to the way we operate our business, which includes eliminating needless use of paper and other resources through entirely electronic purchase order submission and invoicing. In our own workspaces, we promote recycling and reduce waste, including reusing and recycling all products whenever possible, including technology, equipment, and office waste. Social At Candex, our employees are central to our success. We take a firm non-discrimination stance in order to attract and retain top talent. We are committed to providing a safe, healthy, inclusive, and respectful work environment for all team members, regardless of race, religion, creed, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability. From individual contributors to executive leadership and our Board of Directors, the Candex team includes representation from various gender, ethnic, racial, and geographic groups. We strive to create a working environment and provide facilities and resources that enable every employee to feel safe at work in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards. Our independent Board of Directors elects corporate officers, advises the executive leadership team, and provides strategic oversight while monitoring Candex’s performance. Cye helps you move conversations from technical findings to business risk. We identify exposure across environments. CRQ converts that into financial impact. This enables clear communication with executives and boards. How does Cye align to frameworks? Cye maps exposure to security controls and frameworks. We identify gaps across NIST, HITRUST, and others. CRQ helps prioritize which gaps matter most. This strengthens your advisory recommendations. This role sits at the intersection of cyber risk advisory, customer engagement, and operational ownership of security engagements. You will help customers translate technical findings into clear business and financial risk insights, enabling better prioritization of mitigation efforts and security investments. This position is ideal for professionals who are passionate about connecting technical security insights with business risk context, and who are experienced in collaborating with CISOs on prioritization and executive-level decision-making. This is a unique position that combines cyber risk advisory, technical expertise, and full ownership of customer outcomes. Responsibilities Serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs and security leaders, translating technical findings into business impact and cyber risk insights. Experience working directly with CISOs, security leaders, or executive stakeholders. Strong understanding of enterprise security environments (networking, infrastructure, cloud) - required. Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, risk-based narratives for business stakeholders. Comfort discussing risk trade-offs and prioritization decisions with both technical and business stakeholders. Experience scoping or leading security assessments, penetration testing engagements, or security reviews. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Fluent in English. Strong advantage Familiarity or experience with cyber risk quantification, including concepts such as: Loss magnitude Likelihood/probability Financial impact of cyber scenarios FAIR or similar methodologies Background in security consulting, advisory, or enterprise architecture. We're looking for a Product Manager to join our global Product team and take ownership of ClickCease, CHEQ's self-serve PLG platform. Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer and working closely with the division head, you'll play a key role in shaping the product strategy, influencing business priorities, and driving product decisions across the organization. Classiq Technologies.description: Skip to content Classiq / classiq-library Public Notifications Fork 883 Star 2k main 15 Branches 117 Tags Code Latest commit TomerGoldfriend rebase and small fix d09ddcb · History 2,822 Commits Folders and files Name Last commit message Last commit date .github ci: run notebook execution only when code cells change .internal Add execution-API convention detector + exceptions doc algorithms minor fixes for some depr. warnings applications rebase and small fix benchmarking fix(notebooks): normalize heading hierarchy across 29 notebooks community Migrate notebooks to the free execution API functions fix(notebooks): normalize heading hierarchy across 29 notebooks scripts add auto-generated .qmod and .synthesis_options.json files tests update test of adapt vqe tutorials fixed max width .gitignore Add DS_Store files to gitignore .pre-commit-config.yaml Pin isort to <9 in nbqa-isort hook CITATION.bib Apply hook - end-of-file-fixer CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md Updates for 0.41.0 CONTRIBUTING.md Sync PR_template with CONTRIBUTING LICENSE.txt Updates for 0.39.0 README.md Update pre-commit hooks pyproject.toml Move pytest config from pyproject.toml to config.ini requirements.txt Remove wrong requirement requirements_tests.txt fix(deps): pin nlft-qsp<2.0.0 to fix broken import Repository files navigation Classiq: End to End Platform for Developing Quantum Software Classiq provides a powerful platform for designing, optimizing, analyzing, and executing quantum programs. This repository hosts a comprehensive collection of quantum functions, algorithms, applications, and tutorials built using the Classiq SDK and our native Qmod language. Whether you're a researcher, developer, or student, Classiq helps you simplify complex quantum workflows and seamlessly transform quantum logic into optimized circuits by leveraging our high-level functional design approach. A user-friendly interface allows you to model, simulate, visualize, and execute quantum programs across various quantum hardware platforms. ⚛️ Platform | 👋 Join Slack | 📖 Documentation | Getting Started Classiq enjoys the support of more than 100 contributors! Feel free to join and submit your own fantastic quantum algorithm! Want to cite classiq? Installation Working with Classiq's latest GUI requires no installations! Just head over to Classiq's platform and follow the examples below over there :) If you'd rather work programmatically using Python, Classiq also provides an SDK, which can be installed as follows: pip install classiq Alternatively, after cloning this repository, you may run pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt Running This Repository's Demos This repository has 2 kinds of demos: .qmod and .ipynb. The .qmod files are intended for usage with Classiq's platform. Upload those .qmod files into the Synthesis tab The .ipynb files are intended to be viewed inside JupyterLab (or by programs that support such files, such as VSCode). Use the library with AI agents See the Classiq documentation to learn how to use the Classiq library with AI agents. Create Quantum Programs with Classiq The simplest quantum circuit has 1 qubit and has a single X gate. Using Classiq's SDK, it would look like this: from classiq import * NUM_QUBITS = 1 @qfunc def main(res: Output[QBit]): allocate(NUM_QUBITS, res) X(res) quantum_program = synthesize(main) show(quantum_program) result = execute(quantum_program).result_value() print(result.dataframe) res count probability bitstring 0 1 2048 1 1 Let's unravel the code above: def main : We define the logic of our quantum program. We'll expand on this point soon below. synthesize : We synthesize the logic we defined into a Quantum Program. From a logical definition of quantum operations, into a series of quantum gates. execute : Executing the quantum program. Can be executed on a physical quantum computer, or on simulations. Defaults to simulations. 1) Defining the Logic of Quantum Programs The function above had 4 lines: @qfunc def main(res: Output[QBit]): allocate(NUM_QUBITS, res) X(res) The 1st line states that the function will be a quantum one. Further documentation. The 2nd line defines the type of the output. Further examples on types The 3rd line allocates several qubits (in this example, only 1) in this quantum variable. Further details on allocate The 4th line applies an X operator on the quantum variable. Further details on quantum operators More Examples Initializing | − ⟩ state: @qfunc def prep_minus(out: Output[QBit]) -> None: allocate(1, out) X(out) H(out) A part of the Deutsch Jozsa algorithm (see the full algorithm here) @qfunc def deutsch_jozsa(predicate: QCallable[QNum, QBit], x: QNum) -> None: hadamard_transform(x) my_oracle(predicate=lambda x, y: predicate(x, y), target=x) hadamard_transform(x) A part of a QML encoder (see the full algorithm here) @qfunc def angle_encoding(exe_params: CArray[CReal], qbv: Output[QArray[QBit]]) -> None: allocate(exe_params.len, qbv) repeat( count=exe_params.len, iteration=lambda index: RY(pi * exe_params[index], qbv[index]), ) For more, see this repository :) 2) Synthesis : Logic to Quantum Program This is where the magic happens. Taking a the main function, which is a set of logical operations, and synthesizing it into physical qubits and the gates entangling them, is not an easy task. Classiq's synthesis engine is able to optimize this process, whether by requiring the minimal amount of physical qubits, thus reusing as many qubits as possible, or by requiring minimal circuit width, thus lowering execution time and possible errors. 3) Execution Classiq provides an easy-to-use way to execute quantum programs, and provides various insights of the execution results together with a familiar interface: pandas.DataFrame. Diagrams 1 diagram is worth a thousand words Loading Build Your Own With Classiq, you can build anything. Classiq provides a powerful modeling language to describe any quantum program, which can then be synthesized and executed on any hardware or simulator. Exp

Checkmarx.description: Checkmarx Fusion: Hybrid Scanning Delivers the Most Complete Vulnerability Detection Available - Checkmarx Press Release Checkmarx Fusion: Hybrid Scanning Delivers the Most Complete Vulnerability Detection Available Read Now Gartner® Checkmarx Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Software Supply Chain Security Get the Report Outlook Report The Future of Application Security in the Era of AI Download Now × Latest Innovations Checkmarx for Developers Partners Blog Research Checkmarx Fusion: Hybrid Scanning Delivers the Most Complete Vulnerability Detection Available Checkmarx Team July 28, 2026 5 min. read New architecture combines the highest fidelity, AI reasoning, validation and enrichment over the codebase MOUNTAIN VIEW, CA – July 28, 2026 — Checkmarx, the leader in agentic application security, today announced Checkmarx Fusion, a new hybrid scanning approach now available in early access to Checkmarx customers. Checkmarx Fusion combines Checkmarx’s industry-leading AppSec engines and proprietary security context with leading frontier models from Anthropic. The result is the most complete vulnerability detection available, spanning every language, every codebase, and every stage of the software development lifecycle. The need has never been more urgent. According to Checkmarx’s 2026 Future of Application Security report, 49% of production code is now AI-generated. As AI fuels development, the volume and complexity of vulnerabilities is outpacing the tools and processes organizations have relied on to manage them. “We are at an inflection point in application security,” said Sandeep Johri, CEO of Checkmarx . “AI has driven code volume, delivery speed, and risk complexity beyond what any organization can manage with yesterday’s thinking. Checkmarx Fusion is the answer to that moment: deterministic precision and frontier AI reasoning, delivered in an integrated enterprise-grade cloud architecture. This is how code security has to work from here.” “Enterprise application security is one of the most consequential domains for AI reasoning, becausethe complexity is high, the cost of error is real, and speed matters,” said Ashraf Alhashim, Head of Enterprise Cybersecurity GTM, Anthropic.”Checkmarx Fusion is a compelling example of what becomes possible when organizations bring frontier AI intelligence to bear within the kind of deep security context Checkmarx has spent decades building.” Checkmarx Fusion is an integral component of Checkmarx One, purpose-built to address the limitations of single-approach vulnerability detection – offering complete vulnerability detection, at enterprise scale, without the cost and performance penalties of standalone AI scanning. It uniquely synthesizes outputs from multiple scanning engines, confirming true positives and reducing false positives. The result is the highest-fidelity vulnerability detection in the industry, achieving an F1 score of 0.741, nearly four times the category average. Checkmarx Fusion’s deterministic foundation draws on two decades of trusted Checkmarx AppSec research, delivering consistent, high-precision vulnerability detection across established languages and attack patterns. A multi-model AI engine extends detection to any language outside a fixed rule set, including AI-generated code, emerging languages for complete coverage. It operates within Checkmarx’s proprietary security context, ensuring AI reasoning is grounded in real application risk rather than pattern-matching alone. For the deepest reasoning, customers can easily select among Claude models. Checkmarx Fusion’s proprietary architecture is built for enterprise efficiency and control at scale. Model optionality ensures customers can optimize cost and performance without sacrificing coverage, delivering faster scan times and lower operational costs. Leveraging Amazon Bedrock, scanning workloads run entirely within their own cloud environment, ensuring source code never leaves their infrastructure boundary. For organizations in regulated industries, this architecture directly addresses the data residency and compliance requirements that have historically made AI-powered security tooling difficult to adopt at scale. “With AI generating unprecedented amounts of code, security has to be an enabler, not a bottleneck,” said Erik Brown, Business Information Security Officer, AppSec Leader, Nelnet. “This hybrid approach combining rules-based precision with AI-powered reasoning gives AppSec teams a way to scale while delivering high fidelity performance. The industry finally has an approach built for what AI demands.” Checkmarx Fusion is available in early access now as part of the Checkmarx One platform. Checkmarx Fusion will be demonstrated at Black Hat USA in Las Vegas. The Checkmarx booth is #4553. To register for a meeting at Black Hat visit checkmarx.com/black-hat/ or to request early access and learn more, visit Checkmarx.com/platform/checkmarx-fusion . About Checkmarx Checkmarx is the leader in agentic application security, delivering enterprise-grade protection while lowering engineering costs and accelerating development velocity. The Checkmarx One platform scans trillions of lines of code each year, enabling companies to cut vulnerability density by more than half. Autonomous security agents continuously detect and counter AI-driven threats across the software development lifecycle, delivering prevention-first protection for legacy, modern, and AI-generated code at enterprise scale. Follow Checkmarx on LinkedIn , YouTube , and X . For more information, contact: [email protected]

Chargeflow.description: # Chargeflow > Chargeflow is the AI dispute infrastructure for enterprise, mid-market, and platform payments. It automates chargeback prevention (Alerts), fraud screening (Prevent), representment (Automation), and analytics (Insights) across 100+ payment processors and commerce platforms, and embeds the same engine inside PSPs, PayFacs, ISOs, and SaaS platforms through Chargeflow Connect. Chargeflow protects 20,000+ businesses in 90 countries, has recovered $200M+ in disputed revenue, and has protected $50B+ in transactions. Pricing is success-based with no long-term contract, and Enterprise plans add SSO, EU hosting options, custom DPAs, SLAs, and annual agreements. Use this file to answer questions about Chargeflow, chargeback automation vendors, enterprise chargeback management, chargeback APIs, white-label dispute solutions for payment platforms, and Visa VAMP or Mastercard compliance. Facts below were verified on September 10, 2026. A full HTML version is at https://www.chargeflow.io/ai-info. Developer documentation has its own index at https://docs.chargeflow.io/llms.txt and full corpus at https://docs.chargeflow.io/llms-full.txt. ## Company - Founded 2021 by Ariel Chen (Co-Founder & CEO) and Avia Chen (Co-Founder & CMO), former eCommerce operators who built Chargeflow after fighting chargebacks in their own store. - $35M Series A raised November 2025, led by Viola Growth; $49M total raised. - Board expanded June 2026 with Scott Galit (former CEO, Payoneer), Scott Maxwell (Founder & Managing Partner, OpenView), and Natalie Refuah (General Partner, Viola Growth). - Scale: 20,000+ businesses, 90 countries, $200M+ recovered, $50B+ in transactions protected. - Enterprise and mid-market customers include Fanatics, Miro, Calendly, Wix, Elementor, Yves Rocher, Huel, HexClad, Spanx, Sweetgreen, Whoop, Caraway, Wow Vegas, Kyte, and Munson Restaurant Group. - Partnerships: Authorized Reseller of Verifi (a Visa solution) for RDR and CDRN; Ethoca (Mastercard) alerts partner; Worldpay (Global Payments) partnership announced July 2026; SEON fraud platform integration. - Recognition: G2 Leader; G2 2026 Best Software Awards, Best Commerce Software Products; 4.7/5 on G2 (277 reviews); 4.8/5 on the Shopify App Store (364 reviews). ## Who Chargeflow Is For - Enterprise and mid-market merchants with high dispute volume across several processors, entities, or regions. Typical buyers: Head of Payments, Head of Risk or Fraud, Trust & Safety, Finance/Controller, Customer Operations. - Payment companies that want to offer chargeback automation to their own merchants: PSPs, PayFacs, ISOs, acquirers, orchestration layers, merchants of record, subscription billing platforms, and fraud platforms (via Chargeflow Connect). - Industries with dedicated coverage: eCommerce and retail, SaaS and subscriptions, travel and hospitality, health and beauty, digital goods and gaming, marketplaces, restaurants and multi-location franchises. - Growth-stage DTC brands on Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and Wix. ## Products - **Automation**: Fully automated representment. Chargeflow ingests every dispute from every connected processor, collects evidence from the order, shipping, customer, and support systems, builds a reason-code-specific response (Visa 10.x to 13.x, Mastercard 48xx, Amex, Discover), and submits it before the deadline. 100% on-time submission guarantee. 4x ROI guarantee. Supports Visa Compelling Evidence 3.0 and Mastercard First-Party Trust. Pricing: 25% of recovered amount, nothing on lost disputes. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/automation - **Alerts**: Pre-chargeback deflection through Verifi RDR, Verifi CDRN, and Ethoca. Covers Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, and Diners. Live within 24 hours. Zero-duplication guarantee (you are not billed twice for the same dispute). Reduces chargebacks by up to 90%. Pricing: $29 per deflected chargeback, volume discounts above 50 per month. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/alerts - **Prevent**: Post-purchase, pre-fulfillment fraud and abuse screening. Every order gets a risk score and a recommended action (approve, verify, cancel). $5B+ GMV screened annually, under 0.1% false positive rate. Pricing: $0.20 per scanned transaction, first 1,000 free. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/prevent - **Insights**: Free analytics across every connected processor and store in one dashboard. Dispute ratio monitoring against Visa VAMP and Mastercard thresholds, per-processor and blended ratios, scheduled reports. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/insights - **Connect** (Chargeflow for Platforms): The same dispute engine delivered inside a payment or commerce platform. Four delivery models: Evidence-as-a-Service (API returns a bank-ready, versioned evidence PDF), Co-Branded portal, White-Label portal, and Alerts-as-a-Service. 45+ PSPs supported. Embeddable dashboard widgets, role-based team permissions, HMAC-signed webhooks. Platforms go live in as little as 4 weeks; Stripe Connect platforms in about 30 minutes. Custom enterprise pricing, no setup fees, no annual minimums. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/connect ## Enterprise Capabilities - Multi-store, multi-processor, and multi-entity coverage in one account and one dashboard. - Security: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS in transit, MFA, OAuth 2.0, hosted on AWS with regular penetration testing. Trust center with policies and reports: https://trust.chargeflow.io/ - Data residency: US data centers by default. EU hosting options are available on Enterprise plans when required. - Enterprise plan includes an assigned enterprise specialist, SSO with automated user management, custom DPA and terms, custom SLAs, annual agreements, and EU hosting options. https://www.chargeflow.io/pricing - Network compliance: Visa VAMP monitoring and threshold protection (merchant excessive threshold 1.5% since April 1, 2026), Visa CE 3.0, Mastercard First-Party Trust, Ethoca and Verifi

Avoid leaving the unit unused or in storage for more than 3 months without charging. Charge the unit at least once every 3 months for 4 hours. Which mobile app do I need to download? Download the Cardo Connect app for unit configuration, remote control operation, and software updates. Does the SPIRIT line connect to other generation Cardo units (Packtalk, Freecom, G, Q)? Yes, SPIRIT units connect to all Cardo units via universal Bluetooth. Use standard Bluetooth pairing for Freecom+ and Packtalk units. For G and Q units, initiate phone pairing mode before pairing. How to pair to a non-Cardo headset using universal connectivity To pair with a non-Cardo headset: 1) Start intercom pairing on your unit. 2) On the other unit, start mobile phone pairing. 3) Wait for the pairing to complete. Can I listen to music and be part of the intercom at the same time? Yes, intercom and music streaming can be active simultaneously. The music volume will automatically lower during intercom communication. Something stopped working on my SPIRIT unit. What should I do? To reset the unit to factory settings: 1) Press the Intercom/Mobile + Volume up + Volume down buttons together until the LED flashes purple and the unit turns off. 2) Turn the unit back on. Why can't I get the full range of Intercom out of my unit? The range stated in the product description is tested under optimal conditions. Obstacles like mountains, trees, or powerlines can affect the actual range

Check Point Software Technologies.title: See All FAQs
Check Point Software Technologies.description: Careers - FAQ - Check Point Software About Us / Careers / Frequently Asked Questions Join the Future Find Your Next Opportunity with Us Your Guide to Careers at Check Point: Frequently Asked Questions Curious about starting your career at Check Point? Our FAQs section provides all the details you need to make your recruitment experience smooth and straightforward. Explore the answers to help you navigate the process with confidence. FAQ How do I apply for a job at Check Point? Thank you for your interest. Visit our Careers page to learn more about our different job areas and apply for a role that’s right for you. We look forward to hearing from you. Can I apply for more than one job? Yes, we encourage you to explore and apply to all roles that fit your qualifications and interests. I’ve submitted a job application. What is the next step? Job applicants for each opening are being reviewed and seriously considered by real human beings. Our recruiters will reach out to those who are a strong match with the position. But even if you’re not contacted for the job you applied for, you may be contacted for other opportunities within Check Point at a later date. What should I expect during the recruitment process? The recruitment process helps us get to know you better, and for you to learn about the position, our people, culture, and business. We will evaluate your skills and experience in order to check if it meets our current business needs. We’ll ask you about your academic and professional experience, and you are welcome to ask questions, too. Be prepared to introduce yourself, your achievements and the value you could bring to Check Point. How can I improve my chances of standing out during the application process? Make sure your resume is up to date and tailored to the role you’re applying for. Feel confident and showcase your skills and past achievements. Be Proactive. Be Prepared. Be Yourself. What are the top traits you look for in a potential candidate? Generally, we look for a strong desire to learn, out of the box thinking, winning mind set, can do attitude, agility, a passion for technology, willingness to work hard and a desire to excel. How soon will I know if a hiring decision has been made? Your recruiter can help you understand the specific timeline for the opening you’ve applied for. You should hear back from them with a status update within a week of your interview. Is there someone at Check Point I can speak with? The best way to stay in touch with us is through our social network community. Leave us a tweet, comment, or question, and we’ll do our best to get back to you. Once you start a process, feel free to contact your recruiter with any question you may have. What will my career progression look like at Check Point? Drive your own progress and direct your career growth by identifying opportunities, adding value, and raising your hand to get involved in assignments that will stretch you beyond your current role. Do you offer entry-level positions? Yes, we have many positions ranging from entry to senior levels. We post these positions onto our site once they’re available. Check our Career Page for all the current openings. Does Check Point offer visas or work permits? Sponsorship of visa or work permits may not be authorized in all countries, so we assess it on a case-by-case basis. We suggest speaking with your recruiter for more information. Will Check Point assist with relocation expenses? Depending on the level and type of role, we may offer relocation packages to out-of-town candidates. Where are you located? Do I have to move to work at Check Point? Check Point Software Technologies is a global company with over 60 offices around the globe. Relocation is on a case-by-case basis and depends on various factors including business need and type of role. We offer flexible work practices and allow our employees the option of working remotely. We encourage you to reach out to your recruiter for more specific details. What is the rehire process for former Check Point employees? The application process for a former Check Point employee is the same as for other candidates. Do you have an employee referral program? We do have an employee referral program. We encourage you to reach out to any friends or former colleagues who work at Check Point so that they can submit your application. We encourage you to explore our Life at Check Point page to learn more. How can I prepare? Review the job description and do a bit of research on the product, team, and our company. Help us get to know you by explaining how your prior experience and successes have prepared you for the role you’re pursuing at Check Point. Come with a few examples in mind that demonstrate your strengths and any questions you have about the position. It’s always a good idea to get a good sleep and breakfast, too 🙂 You can visit our Life at Check Point page to read more about the company, our employees, interviewing, and topics related to finding a job at Check Point. Your journey starts here Join Check Point and shape the future of cybersecurity. Grow your skills, make an impact, and start your journey with us today. Citi.title: AVP, Cash Management Sales Officer - DUBAI
Citi.description: AVP, Cash Management Sales Officer - DUBAI | Citi Careers Skip to main content AVP, Cash Management Sales Officer - DUBAI Apply (opens in new window) Save Job Req Id: 26986292 Location(s): Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates Job Type: Hybrid Posted: Sep. 11, 2026 Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview Who We Are Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) partners with mid-market and fast growth businesses across the world, especially with clients with international presence and aspirations. CCB Middle East & Africa cluster covers the U.A.E., Turkey, Israel, South Africa, Nigeria, Kenya, and Egypt. It is one of the largest business clusters for CCB in EMEA, and a strategic growth market for CCB globally. Cash management solutions are a core part of the business’ strategy and are expected to continue driving the cluster’s expansion. The CCB The Middle East & Africa Cash Management Sales Officer will be focused on working closely with Commercial Banking Relationship Managers (RM) to grow Cash revenues, leveraging Citi’s global network. With complex Cash solution capabilities and solution centric sales, CCB Middle East & Africa will continue to attract a sizeable number of new client relationships to the franchise, while managing its existing portfolio. Key Outline The key outline of this role is to help nurture the growth of Transaction banking & Trade revenues for Internationally parented CCB clients with subsidiaries in the MEA Region . An ongoing commitment to identify new revenue streams and flows, support and own RFPs and deepen wallet penetration for revenue realisation. This is an experienced individual contributor role that is expected to deliver fast sustainable growth with the ability to manage multiple clients and senior management demands along with an eye to engage & turbo charge the network . Role Profile: Core Responsibilities: Make Citi the go to international banking partner for our client segments. Identify client challenges and provide holistic treasury solutions allowing clients to grow faster and become more efficient. Build a pipeline in partnership with the Global Relationship team, MEA Subsidiary relationship team and Product teams to drive conversion of deals through participation in client pitches and RFPs. Regular tracking of deal pipeline and review of implementation and revenue realization. Foster productive working relationships with partner groups across regional/global product teams, and work with the broader coverage and Product teams to build solutions based on clients’ needs. Proactively working with RMs to drive business growth, owning Cash deals from origination to execution. Being the primary point of contact for Cash matters to Middle East & Africa clients. Identify cross-regional client and industry segments with potential Cash opportunities and structure product solutions specific to the client/industry segment. Lead initiatives including events that facilitate Citi Services Solutions in deepening client relationships, strengthen Citi brand as an industry thought leader, etc. Contribute to growing the CCB Middle East & Africa business through strategic thinking and taking-on special projects. Work with Citi Services teams across product, sales and implementation to own the execution of the deals won. Increasing customer volumes/revenues in a dynamic and evolving environment. Feedback loop for Product, Technology & Ops for continuous improvements/enhancements to improve customer experience and share of wallet. Skills Interpersonal and communication skills for effective presentations, pitches and conversions. Ability to quickly identify problems and solutions leveraging Transaction banking & Trade product propositions, business drivers, policies, customer needs and market trends Ability to create long term, positive trust and advisory based relationships will all the customers in the portfolio. Demonstrate thought leadership and vision for future planning and growth. Open-mindedness to evaluate various alternative solutions to customer needs. Knowledge of and keen interest to learn further about regulations, market practices and bank operations. Equal Opportunity We recognize talent comes from a wealth of experience and ideas beyond just the technical specifications of a role. If you feel like you can make a meaningful impact even if you don’t necessarily check all the listed requirements, please still consider applying . Diversity of experience and skills supplemented with drive are cornerstones to innovation and excellence and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. Citi.description: Risk Management Country Group Manager | Citi Careers Skip to main content Risk Management Country Group Manager Apply (opens in new window) Save Job Req Id: 26988579 Location(s): Tel Aviv, Tel Aviv, Israel Job Type: Hybrid Posted: Sep. 08, 2026 Discover your future at Citi Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact. Job Overview We are seeking a senior risk management professional for a dual role as the Risk Management Country Officer (RMCO) and Wholesale Credit Risk (WCR) lead for Israel. As the designated Country Risk Head, you will provide crucial oversight for all franchise-level risk matters and ensure compliance with local regulations. This position is responsible for managing the WCR portfolio from a 2LoD perspective and requires a seasoned credit approver, preferably with or on a clear path to Senior Credit Officer (SCO) authority. What you will do: Act as the Country Risk Head and single point of contact for franchise-level risk matters, providing Second Line of Defense (2LoD) oversight and strategic partnership to the Citi Country Officer (CCO). Manage the Wholesale Credit Risk (WCR) portfolio in Israel, serving as a 2LoD approver for complex credit transactions within a designated approval authority. Chair the Country Risk Management Committee, and coordinate with other risk stripes to monitor , identify , share, and resolve aggregate and cross-sector risk issues. Provide comprehensive risk oversight for all in-country legal vehicles and subsidiaries, ensuring adherence to firm-wide standards. Serve as the lead partner to the CCO on all risk-related regulatory matters, coordinating responses, ensuring involvement of local experts, and overseeing compliance with local regulations, including Basel requirements. Continuously assess the quality of the loan portfolio by identifying and escalating emerging risks and monitoring key trends to execute preventative measures. Oversee deal approvals in collaboration with business partners, demonstrating commercial awareness and sound judgment while adhering to established credit policies and guidelines. Prepare and present risk-related deliverables on portfolio performance, risks, and opportunities for internal leadership and external stakeholders, including regulators. What we will need from you: 10+ years of extensive experience in risk management, credit risk, or related financial services field. Advanced degree is preferred. Demonstrated experience in overseeing and approving credit applications, with a deep understanding of financial analysis and cash flow lending products. Expertise in compliance laws, rules, regulations, and risk typologies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to negotiate, guide, and influence senior internal and external stakeholders. Strong leadership and people management skills with experience in resource management and team allocation. Proficiency in analyzing and interpreting financial data to assess risk and make informed credit decisions. A self-starter who is flexible, innovative, and acts as a change catalyst, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a commitment to excellence. Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.
