חבילת הנגשה לאתר 1. תוסף נגישות בהתאמה לתקן 5568/AA התקנת תוסף נגישות של Vee באתר שלך, תסייע למשתמשים בעלי מוגבלויות שונות לעשות שימוש אפקטיבי בשירותים המוצעים בו. לאחר ההתקנה של תוסף נגישות, האתר שלך יהיה נגיש לעיוורים ומוגבלי ראיה, בעלי מוגבלות פיזית המתקשים להפעיל את ידיהם, בעלי מוגבלויות קוגניטיביות כגון דיסלקציה והפרעות קשב וריכוז, כבדי שמיעה ובעלי מוגבלויות נוספות. לכל המסלולים והחבילות 2. התאמה אישית של הצהרת נגישות משפטית הצגת הצהרת נגישות באתר היא חובה על פי חוק. לאחר הנגשת האתר לפי תקן 5568 – AA, הצוות המשפטי שלנו יפיק עבורך מסמך הצהרת נגישות הכולל בין היתר: פירוט פעולות הנגישות באתר, הסדרי נגישות פיזיים, מינוי ופרסום פרטי רכז/ת נגישות ועוד. המסמך ינוסח תוך התייחסות להנחיות והקריטריונים הרלוונטיים לעסק שלך. למידע על הצהרת נגישות 3. בדיקה ידנית של קוד האתר ע"י צוות מומחי הנגישות שלנו יש לך אתר שאופיין ועוצב בקפידה, אבל מה קורה מתחת "לפני השטח"? לבנייה נכונה ומדויקת של האתר יש חשיבות גדולה ואלמנטים שלא הוגדרו נכון עלולים לפגוע בתהליך ההנגשה. מומחי הנגישות שלנו יסרקו את האתר שלך, ימפו את התבניות שבו ויעברו על האלמנטים והטפסים המרכזיים. בסיום התהליך, יופק דו"ח ליקויי נגישות (במידה ויש) ויוצעו פתרונות פשוטים לתיקון. בדיקת נגישות לאתר כמה עולה הנגשת אתר? חבילת הנגשת אתרים מקצועית הכוללת תוסף נגישות מתקדם, בדיקת קוד ידנית והצהרת נגישות משפטית. רישיון שנתי לשירות הנגשה מלא בהתאמה לתקן הנגישות הישראלי 5568 ברמת AA. הנגשת אתר מיועד לאתרי מסחר ותדמית הגנה מפני תביעות ישירות הצהרת נגישות מותאמת עד 10,000 דפים באתר ללא הגבלת שפות שליטה בעיצוב אייקון נגישות ליווי וייעוץ מומחה נגישות בדיקה ידנית של קוד האתר 500ש"ח /לשנה המחיר אינו כולל מע"מ הוספה לסל הנגשת אתר לאתרים גדולים/מורכבים הגנה מפני תביעות ישירות הצהרת נגישות מותאמת עד 100,000 דפים באתר ללא הגבלת שפות שליטה בעיצוב אייקון נגישות ליווי וייעוץ מומחה נגישות דו"ח מומחה נגישות 800ש"ח /לשנה המחיר אינו כולל מע"מ הוספה לסל הנגשת אתר - פרימיום הגנה מפני תביעות ישירות הצהרת נגישות מותאמת ללא הגבלת דפים ללא הגבלת שפות שליטה בעיצוב אייקון נגישות מומחה נגישות אישי עד 4 דו"חות מומחה נגישות 1200ש"ח /לשנה המחיר אינו כולל מע"מ הוספה לסל למה לבחור ב-Vee להנגשת האתר תוסף נגישות AA 0 חיסכון בעלויות הנגשה % 0 ניצול התנועה באתר % 0 ראש שקט % 0 שאלות נפוצות אספנו עבורך את התשובות לשאלות הנפוצות ביותר עבור הנגשת אתרים. עלתה לך שאלה שלא מופיעה פה? אנחנו מחכים לך עם התשובה במרכז המידע שלנו וגם זמינים בשירות הלקוחות. למרכז המידע מה הוא חוק הנגישות בישראל? מה היא הצהרת נגישות ולמה צריך אותה? מי זכאי ל-60 ימי חסד להגנה מפני תביעות? אילו עסקים חייבים בנגישות אתר האינטרנט שלהם על פי חוק? הנגשת אתר- איך זה עובד? אילו תכנים מחוייבים בנגישות? כיצד אבטיח שתוסף הנגישות באתר שלי עומד בתקן? האם תוסף הנגישות משפיע על מהירות האתר? אלו סוגי אתרים חייבים בהנגשה על פי חוק? זאת החובה שלנו בעלי מוגבלויות מהווים כ-17% מכלל האוכלוסיה בישראל. אתרים רבים אינם נגישים כיום ולכן לא מאפשרים לפלח אוכלוסיה זה להנות משירותי אונליין כמו שאר האנשים. מזמינים אתכם לצטרף לאלפי אתרים שכבר מנגישים את התוכן שלהם. יחד נוכל לאפשר לעוד שירות או מוצר להיות נגיש לכל אותם אנשים שהם חלק בלתי נפרד מהחברה שלנו. הנגשת אתרים בפלטפורמות הפופולריות ביותר תהליך התקנה ידידותי ונוח לכולם המערכת שלנו מכירה אתכם מתחילים בהרשמה לשירות והזנת פרטי אתר ועסק. אוטומציה מתקדמת לאחר ניתוח הנתונים, קוד לתוסף + הצהרת נגישות מותאמים יחכו לך באיזור האישי. התקנה פשוטה יישום והתקנת הנגישות באתר עפ"י מדריך התקנה. בדיקה ידנית צוות מומחה הנגישות שלנו עובר ובודק את קוד האתר שלך, לוודא עמידה בתקן. מידע נוסף אנחנו פה לכל שאלה וייעוץ הפרטיות שלכם חשובה לנו אנו משתמשים בקבצי Cookie כדי לשפר את חוויית הגלישה, להציג תוכן מותאם אישית ולנתח את התנועה באתר. באפשרותכם לאשר את כל קבצי ה-Cookie, לדחות קבצים שאינם הכרחיים או לנהל את ההעדפות שלכם. מדיניות פרטיות נפתח בלשונית חדשה דחה הכל ניהול קבצי Cookie קבל הכל מופעל על ידי Data Lock

This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. More information Strictly Necessary Cookies Always Active These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information. Performance Cookies Performance Cookies These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance. Functional Cookies Functional Cookies These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly. Targeting Cookies Targeting Cookies These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

See our open positions ← All Jobs Principal UX Expert Austin, TX About The Position Stampli is building finance software in a new way: AI-native, grounded in real financial workflows, and shaped by people who understand the work deeply. We are looking for a Principal UX Expert who can develop a deep understanding of the people we build for — from finance teams to procurement, reimbursement, and card-holding employees across the business, and the executives who decide whether to buy. Your job is to ensure we understand the persona and the problem before solutions are designed, so the right questions are asked early and UX gaps are caught before Design Review. This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting to the VP of Product. You will be a leading source of US customer insight inside Product — close to the market, close to Sales and Customer Success, and a trusted partner to our Product Managers and design team. You will work alongside our design leadership, learning from each other and raising the bar on how deeply we understand our users and decision-makers. This is not primarily a production-design role. Your impact comes from sharp customer insight, strong product judgment, and the ability to challenge and coach the teams around you. You may also work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and other design artifacts when that is the most effective way to test an idea or improve a solution. What You Will Do Run ongoing user research to build a first-hand understanding of Stampli’s users, buyers, administrators, and decision-makers — and learn where the product resonates, where prospects push back, and why. Partner with Product Managers to validate the target persona and problem from feature initiation through Product Review, clarifying the real problem, workflow, and intended outcome. Partner with Product Managers and designers from feature initiation through Design Review, bringing customer context, challenging assumptions, and surfacing persona gaps, missing scenarios, and usability risks. Build and maintain Stampli’s persona libraries and operationalize them through AI-powered UX evaluation tools — including agents, skills, guardrails, and evaluators — that assess product concepts, prototypes, and designs throughout discovery and development. Create or contribute to wireframes and prototypes when hands-on exploration is the most effective way to test a concept, communicate a recommendation, or improve a solution. Partner with Product Marketing to shape product and UX copy and messaging based on deep persona and business-context understanding. Partner with Product and Product Marketing on Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Product-Led Sales (PLS) experiments, helping identify the right flow for each feature, upsell, decision-maker, and business context. What You Will Bring 10+ years in UX, product design, service design, user research, or product strategy — with a track record of turning customer insight into shipped product. A proven approach to deep user research — customer calls, recorded onboardings and demos, and behavioral analytics such as FullStory — and the ability to turn it into clear, actionable insight. Senior in-house UX experience at a high-craft B2B SaaS product, or a background at a top-tier design or product consultancy. In either environment, you have remained accountable through implementation, launch, and iteration. Deep understanding of finance personas and workflows — accounts payable, procurement, controllership, ERP, or fintech — and the ability to understand how these personas work, make decisions, and evaluate solutions. Ability to apply deep persona and business-context understanding to product copy, UX copy, and messaging. Experience with growth experimentation and a strong understanding of growth levers across Product-Led Growth and Product-Led Sales. Strong systems thinking and product judgment, with the ability to challenge teams constructively and work hands-on with wireframes and prototypes when useful. Comfort working across Product, Design, Sales, Customer Success, and Product Marketing — and across US and Israel time zones. Hands-on experience structuring research into reusable persona libraries, evaluation criteria, and AI workflows, including building or configuring agents, skills, guardrails, and evaluators for research, prototyping, and product-quality assessment. You Will Get The flexibility of working from our Austin office three days a week, with the option to work remotely for the remainder of the week. Full medical, dental, and vision insurance. 401(k) with employer match. Access to cutting-edge AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise, to enhance productivity, support innovation, and streamline daily workflows. Opportunities and development for career and personal growth. The base salary range for this position is $160,000- $180,000 plus Equity. More Info StoreNext is proud to present a revolutionary service that allows large organizations (with over 1000 vendor invoices per month), to switch to 100% digital invoices in about one month! In addition, the service also incorporates a digital archive for storing invoices as well as an online vendor portal to view the status of invoices to vendors. Invoices Digitization Process All vendor invoices go to the scan office of ImageStore Systems, where they go through an end-to-end digitization process until they are converted from paper to legally digitally signed and decrypted files, using an advanced OCR engine and additional human-controlled control. The files are transmitted directly to the organization’s ERP system for further processing and approval, and at the same time are archived in a digital archive and displayed to providers on a dedicated Internet portal. Steps In The Process Main Benefits 100% of vendor invoices are accepted as digital from day one. Standardization and control of the invoicing process. Invoices of any type or format are processed, scanned, stored and routed, as digital files directly to ERP. Significant savings in invoice receipt and approval. Smart Shooter.description: Careers - smart-shooter Careers To ultimately revolutionize the world of small arms and optics by enabling every shooter to hit his target while being a part of a smart, precise, and connected unit. ← All Jobs קניינ/ית רכש Israel About The Position קניין/ית רכש התפקיד כולל הובלת תהליכי רכש אסטרטגיים ותפעוליים בארגון. איתור ספקים, ניהול משא ומתן, הוזלת עלויות ושיפור זמני אספקה, לצד עבודה צמודה עם צוותי פיתוח, הנדסה וייצור. תחומי אחריות ניהול מקצה לקצה של תהליכי רכש טכנולוגי משלב קבלת הדרישה, דרך הצעות מחיר, ניהול מו”מ, הקמת ההזמנה ומעקב משלוחים איתור, פיתוח וניהול קשרי ספקים עבודה מול קבלני משנה בתחומי ייצור והרכבות סנכרון שוטף מול מחלקות הנדסה, פיתוח ותפעול לתמיכה בצרכי הייצור והפרויקטים. עבודה מול מערכת ה ERP לעדכון הזמנות, נתונים ומעקב מלאי. עמידה ביעדי חיסכון, איכות ולוחות זמנים. Requirements דרישות התפקיד לפחות 5 שנות ניסיון כקניין/ית בחברה תעשייתית/טכנולוגית – חובה היכרות וניסיון מוכח ברכש בתחומי האלקטרוניקה, האופטיקה והמכניקה אנגלית ברמה גבוהה מאוד (דיבור, כתיבה וניהול מו”מ מסחרי) – חובה. שליטה במערכות ERP – חובה. ניסיון בעבודה עם מערכת Priority – יתרון משמעותי ניסיון בניהול רכש מול קבלני משנה (Subcontractors) – יתרון משמעותי י כולת מוכחת בניהול מו”מ מורכב, ראייה מערכתית, יחסי אנוש מעולים ויכולת עבודה עצמאית בסביבה מרובת משימות. ניסיון בניהול רכש בינלאומי, עבודה מול ספקים בחו”ל והיכרות עם תהליכי יבוא. Smart Shooter.title: טכנאי/ת מעבדה Israel
Smart Shooter.description: Careers - smart-shooter Careers To ultimately revolutionize the world of small arms and optics by enabling every shooter to hit his target while being a part of a smart, precise, and connected unit. ← All Jobs טכנאי/ת מעבדה Israel About The Position דרוש/ה טכנאי/ת מעבדה Smart Shooter היא חברה ציבורית ישראלית בתחום ההגנה וביטחון העוסקת בפיתוח ובייצור של מערכות בקרת ירי חכמות לנשק קל. באמצעות טכנולוגיות מתקדמות של עיבוד תמונה ובינה מלאכותית המערכות מגדילות את דיוק הירי ומשפרות באופן ניכר את אחוזי הפגיעה במגוון סוגי מטרות (קרקעיות, אוויריות, סטטיות או נעות, ביום ובלילה). החברה מפתחת, משווקת ומייצרת מערכות בתחומי האלאקטרואופטיקה ומציאות רבודה לכוחות הלוחמים ביבשה, באוויר ובים. התפקיד כולל: ביצוע אבחון, איתור ותיקון תקלות במערכות החברה המגיעות למעבדה. איתור תקלות בכרטיסים אלקטרוניים עד רמת רכיב וביצוע תיקונים בהתאם. הרכבה, פירוק והחלפת מכלולים אלקטרוניים ומכניים. ביצוע צריבות, כיולים ובדיקות תקינות לאחר התיקון. תיעוד פעולות התיקון במערכות החברה. עבודה מול ממשקים פנימיים, בהם צוותי פיתוח, ייצור ואינטגרציה, לצורך פתרון תקלות ושיפור תהליכים. Requirements דרישות ניסיון קודם בתחזוקת ציוד טכני, מכני או מבצעי – חובה. רקע בעבודה עם נשק, מערכות נשק או ציוד צבאי – יתרון משמעותי. ניסיון באיתור תקלות בכרטיסים אלקטרוניים עד רמת רכיב – יתרון משמעותי. הנדסאי/ת אלקטרוניקה/מכונות – יתרון משמעותי. ניסיון בהרכבה והחלפת מכלולים אלקטרוניים. אנגלית טכנית ברמה טובה. נכונות לנסיעות עבודה לחו”ל מעת לעת. היקף המשרה: משרה מלאה, ימים א’–ה’ ממשרדי החברה Apply for this position We use cookies on our website to give you the most relevant experience by remembering your preferences and repeat visits. Smart Shooter.description: Careers - smart-shooter Careers To ultimately revolutionize the world of small arms and optics by enabling every shooter to hit his target while being a part of a smart, precise, and connected unit. ← All Jobs Computer Vision & Image Processing Engineer Israel About The Position Smart Shooter is seeking a highly skilled Computer Vision & Image Processing Engineer to join our innovative team in developing cutting-edge technology solutions. In this role, you will design, develop, and implement cutting-edge image processing and computer vision algorithms. You will work on complex, real-world visual tasks, taking algorithms from theoretical concepts to production-grade deployment on cutting-edge systems. ﻿About Smart Shooter Smart Shooter is a world-class designer, developer, and manufacturer of innovative Fire Control Systems that significantly increase the accuracy and lethality of small arms. With a rich record in designing unique solutions for the warfighter, Smart-Shooter’s technology enhances mission effectiveness through the ability to accurately engage and eliminate ground, aerial, static or moving targets during day and night operations. Key Responsibilities Research, design, and develop innovative computer vision and image processing algorithms. Implement and train Deep Learning models tailored for challenging visual tasks. Optimize algorithms and write scalable, clean, and efficient production code. Collaborate closely with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions. Requirements Requirements Education & Experience: M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field—with a distinct specialization in Computer Vision or Pattern Recognition. At least 3 years of proven industry experience developing algorithms in the fields of Image Processing and Computer Vision. Technical Skills: In-depth knowledge and hands-on experience in classic Image Processing & Computer Vision methods. Strong familiarity with Deep Learning frameworks and solutions for complex visual tasks. Extensive, hands-on experience in C and C++ programming for large-scale applications. Advantages (Nice to Have) Experience implementing and deploying algorithms on low-power, Real-Time (RT) Embedded systems. Practical knowledge and programming experience in Python . The first 24-48 hours are critical in the battle against attackers. Quick, precise, and well-informed decisions are essential. You don’t want to be thinking about how to react during a real crisis: you need to know how to react. Sygnia’s Tabletop Wargames are designed to strengthen the cyber security awareness and ability of corporate leadership to guide the organization through a major cyber crisis. They enable leadership to understand the typical flow of an incident, roles and responsibilities in a crisis, and stress-test key processes while tackling complex challenges. Sygnia leverages extensive front-line experience responding to major, heavy-weight cyber attacks, to create realistic attack scenarios that generate pragmatic takeaways for our clients. Sygnia offers several types of wargames, each tuned to the needs and alignment of different leadership teams in the organization: Key Benefits Improve executive ability to lead the organization through a cyber crisis Stress-test key functions, including communication and collaboration Understand the flow of an incident and key decision points Identify opportunities to improve incident readiness Wargame Challenges Risk-based decision making Roles and responsibilities Leadership in a crisis Fiduciary responsibilities Protecting and recovering IT systems in alignment with business priorities Ransom negotiation and payment Public and regulatory disclosure Making decisions with partial visibility and incomplete forensic evidence Internal and external communications Brand and reputational risk Wargame Challenges High-Impact Learning Experience in Just 2-3 Hours Wargames are performed as deep-dive tabletop exercises mimicking a major cyber security incident. They are led by Sygnia experts with extensive experience in helping organizations prepare and respond to some of the world’s most sophisticated and dangerous threat groups. The Sygnia team guides participants through a major incident as it would unfold in the company’s IT infrastructure, and provides options and decision-making opportunities at each step, as well as a set of possible outcomes. The wargames focus on agreed-upon high-impact scenarios that are aligned with both current threat trends, and the client’s security and technology environment. Sygnia focuses heavily on techniques that increase participant engagement so that all stakeholders gain value from the exercise. Participants are required to address the major aspects of a heavy-weight attack, including investigation, containment, remediation, recovery, and managing the negative impact on the business. The wargames are designed to run for two to three hours, providing participants with a high-impact learning experience. Decision points and exercise details are tailored to accommodate the different needs and focus areas of each leadership level within the organization. Upon conclusion of the exercise, Sygnia holds a debrief discussion with the client to jointly identify key strengths and opportunities for improvement. An action list is prepared to guide the organization going forward. The Sygnia Advantage Attacker Perspective We employ only highly experienced A-teams with extensive nation-state level cyber warfare backgrounds, offensive and defensive capabilities, and decades of incident response experience. Our teams are able to out-think, out-maneuver and outpace attackers. Rapid Response Sygnia’s incident response methodology encompasses parallel execution of the wide variety of activities needed to deal with an attack: investigation and forensics, containment, tactical negotiation, remediation & recovery, executive crisis management, litigation support, and post-breach monitoring. Rewards do not expire so long as the account is open, however, in cases where we suspect fraud or abuse, or other suspicious activity with respect to the Program or your Account, any unredeemed Rewards may be forfeited. See the Sunbit Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions for more information. Sunbit Rewards Card: How can I track and / or manage my rewards? You can track and manage your rewards directly from the Sunbit mobile app. Sunbit Rewards Card: Can I apply a statement credit to my minimum payment due? Generally, no, unless the amount you’re redeeming is at least as large as your current outstanding Account Balance. See the Sunbit Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions for more information. Sunbit Rewards Card: What’s the difference between my Available Rewards Balance and Pending Rewards Balance? Why am I seeing two balances? Pending Rewards are rewards that are earned / accrued throughout the current billing cycle. Available Rewards are your rewards available at any given point in time that can be redeemed for statement credit. Only Available Rewards can be redeemed as a statement credit. Pending Rewards cannot be redeemed as a statement credit until they are transferred to your Available Rewards Balance at cycle close. See the Sunbit Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions for more information. Sunbit Rewards Card: How do I redeem rewards? You can redeem rewards at your discretion directly in the Sunbit mobile app (rewards are not redeemed automatically). When you make a redemption, the redeemed amount will be subtracted from your Available Rewards Balance and applied as a statement credit to your outstanding Account Balance. See the Sunbit Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions for more information. Sunbit Rewards Card: How are rewards calculated? We take your net qualifying purchases in a billing cycle i.e. the sum of all of your posted transactions less any returns, reversals, or negative adjustments, and we multiply this figure by 2% to determine your rewards for that cycle. This amount is then added to your available rewards balance in the Sunbit app at cycle close. See the Sunbit Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions for more information. Sunbit Rewards Card: What are Qualifying Purchases? Qualifying Purchases are purchases that are eligible to earn rewards, as defined in the Sunbit Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions. Certain purchases are ineligible to earn rewards such as finance charges, payments, cash advances etc. See the Sunbit Rewards Card Rewards Program Terms and Conditions for more information. Sunbit Rewards Card: How do I earn rewards? Rewards are earned automatically when you make qualifying purchases. Tailor Brands.title: Product Manager https://www.tailorbrands.com/careers · Full-time · Intermediate
Tailor Brands.description: Job opportunity: Product Manager Login ← All Jobs Product Manager https://www.tailorbrands.com/careers · Full-time · Intermediate About The Position We are Tailor Brands We built a platform that builds businesses. From launching and managing to growing your business, Tailor Brands is the all-in-one solution that empowers you. Our “Guidance Engine” assesses each new business that arrives on the platform and devises a tailored plan for it. From formation and compliance to accounting and payments, millions of people choose Tailor Brands for over 20 business services on a single platform. Our mission is to help anyone shape their life by building a business and creating a simple path to independence. There are point solutions for every bump in the road, a tool for each challenge you might face. But we are more than a toolbox, we are your guide. We hand you the compass to chart a smoother course, and turn the journey from complicated to clear, from daunting to doable. Building a business is tough. While 61% of Americans have a plan to start a business, only a third will actually take the steps to make it happen. We believe the present favors independence, but the future will require it. ﻿About the role You own the product end to end: the problem, the prototype, the spec, the release, the experiment, and the call to keep it, change it, or kill it. Which parts of the product you’re focused on follows the opportunities we decide to invest in, and you’ll hold several of them at once. The craft is the same in all of them. Some of what we build is AI itself: an AI co-founder for business owners, and an AI-led signup flow. Some of it is ordinary product work: checkout, pricing, compliance filings, a dashboard. In both cases, AI is how the job gets done here, not a type of project you get assigned. You build the prototype yourself. Our PMs build working prototypes in AI coding tools such as Lovable and Claude Code — alone or with a designer, depending on the project. The prototype goes to engineering as the spec, with real components, real states and real copy. Not a wireframe and a document. You move fast. You have an engineering team building against your decisions, and you are responsible for what they spend their time on. We release several times a day, nothing waits for a quarterly plan, and what you sketch on Monday can be live by Wednesday. You run your own experiments. Design the test, declare the primary metric before you open it, set exposure, get it instrumented with the data team, read it, and call it. Tests run in Statsig, with results in Heap and Tableau, though often we skip the dashboard and have an AI agent read the test straight out of the warehouse. Closing your own test on control is part of the job. You get your own answers. The same habit applies to every question, not only to tests. Instead of filing a request and waiting, you go and find out. You are expected to notice when a number is wrong, and to say so before a decision gets made on it. You own the consequences. When a price renders wrong or a payment method stops appearing on one browser, you are the person who works out how many customers it reached, decides what we do for them, and makes sure it cannot happen the same way twice. You hold the stakeholders. Requests reach you from other product teams, BizDev, Marketing, Finance, Legal, CX and Data, and they will not agree on what matters most. You hear them out, decide what your team takes on and in what order, and tell the people who did not get what they asked for why not. They also need to know what is changing, what it means for their work, and when it lands, before it lands. Requirements 3-5 years in product management, on a consumer or self-serve product. You already build with AI coding tools. This is a requirement, not an advantage. If you have never shipped a working prototype yourself, this role will be frustrating. Deeply analytical. Given a metric that moved, you can break it into the parts that could have moved it, work out which one did, and say how confident you are in the answer. Monetization experience preferred: pricing, packaging, checkout, upsell, billing. These are the decisions that move revenue rather than engagement. Experimentation you have run yourself: designed, powered, read, decided. Be ready to talk about a test you killed and why. Strong stakeholder management. You can hold competing requests from several functions at once, decide what your team takes on, sequence the rest honestly, and keep the people you said no to on your side. Enough UI/UX judgment to design a flow rather than describe one, down to layout, states, empty states and copy. A quantitative B.A./B.Sc. from a leading academic institution (advantage for entrepreneurship programs such as Zell, Adelson, We, Coller Ignite, TAU Up). Working English, written and spoken. Most of our customers and some of our team are native English speakers. You have made something exist that did not exist before, such as a startup, a side project or a product line. Nice to have Domain experience in US small business, fintech or compliance: formation, registered agent, payments, bookkeeping, tax. Experience shipping a partner or channel integration. You have been a small business owner. A link to something you built, such as a prototype, an internal tool or a side project. Send it with your application. This role is probably not for you if You expect a designer to hand you screens and an analyst to hand you numbers. You want to write requirements and hand them over. You want one area that stays yours, with a fixed scope and a quarterly planning cycle. You want one stakeholder and a tidy backlog. “AI-first” reads to you as a line in a job ad rather than a description of the day. Nice to know We are located in Rothschild, Tel Aviv. Our hybrid model includes four days in the office and one day at home. Apply for this position

I understand Skip To Main Content Country Photo of Teva employees in Brazil How We Hire at Teva Our Global Hiring Process Your Guide to the Teva Pharmaceuticals Recruitment Experience Hiring Process Discover our recruitment process at Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company dedicated to better health. We’ve designed this guide to provide a transparent, step-by-step view of our recruitment journey - from submitting your CV to onboarding. Explore what we look for in our talent, find advice on how to prepare for interviews, and see how we support our global workforce with flexible work models and holistic benefits. Whether you're interested in innovative R&D, AI in pharma, early career opportunities or other roles, this is your roadmap to the hiring experience at Teva. Before you apply, learn how to stand out with your application Read more Search Jobs Our Hiring Process At Teva, our medicines reach 155 million patients around the world every day. Because our work matters, how we hire matters too. Across R&D, manufacturing, commercial, and corporate functions such as digital, IT, HR, legal and finance, we bring together people with different experiences and perspectives, all united by a shared purpose: we are all in for better health. We look for people who are curious, humble, and passionate about improving health, who bring energy and optimism to challenges, and who raise the bar by supporting their teams and helping others succeed. "Our hiring experience is designed to be transparent, respectful, and human. Whether you are starting your career journey or bring years of experience, we aim to provide clear information, consistent expectations, and the opportunity to show your strengths and talents throughout the process." Idit Booch, Head of Talent Acquisition at Teva Below, you will find an overview of our hiring process, along with practical tips for each stage. Our goal is to help you understand what to expect and how to make informed decisions about your next career move with Teva. Find the Right Role Online Application Submission Screening Interviews & Assessments Offer & Onboarding Frequently Asked Questions Step 1: Find the Right Role Start by exploring open opportunities on the Teva Careers site. Search Smarter: Use filters for keyword, location, area of interest, and country to find positions that align with your expertise and career interests. Stay Connected: We recommend creating a candidate profile to make the application process easier. With a candidate profile, you can: • Upload your CV • Save jobs to review or apply to later • Apply more quickly for future opportunities • Set up job alerts to be notified when new roles match your interests Step 2: Online Application Submission Once you’ve found a match, our application process is straightforward. You will complete a short online form and upload your CV so we can learn more about your experience, skills, and interests. You will receive a confirmation email once your submission is successful. Know someone who works at Teva? Great! We highly recommend reaching out and applying through them. Important to know: You are welcome to apply to more than one role at Teva. However, we recommend only applying to positions where your skills and experience are the strongest match. Each candidate can apply only once per specific role, so be sure to review your application before submitting. Before applying, we encourage you to learn more about us: What we do at Teva | Our Research & Development pipeline | Company news | Benefits and wellbeing | Growth at Teva | Our values Your CV & Application Tips Your CV is our first opportunity to learn about your experience and impact. We recommend tailoring it to the role you’re applying for, rather than using a single version for every application. A few tips to help you put your best foot forward: Focus on relevance Review the job description and highlight experience, skills, and projects that align most closely with the role. Show your impact Where possible, share specific examples of what you worked on and the outcome. Clear, concrete details help us understand your contribution. Teva Pharmaceuticals.title: Pivot To Growth: The Teva Journey
Teva Pharmaceuticals.description: Skip To Main Content Country Pivot to Growth: The Acceleration Phase FEBRUARY 17, 2026 LEADERSHIP RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT GROWTH INNOVATION Teva’s Pivot to Growth strategy is reshaping the company’s future. As of the end of 2025, Teva has delivered 3 consecutive years of growth, supported by a robust pipeline, and a clear forward vision. At a recent strategy day presentation to industry professionals, CEO Richard Francis explains why now is the time to accelerate. Progress so far In May 2023, Teva President and CEO Richard Francis revealed the company’s Pivot to Growth strategy. Two years on, its successful execution has been clearly demonstrated: 11 consecutive quarters of growth as of Q3 2025 A strong financial performance, with 2024 revenues of $16.5 billion* for the full year reflecting a 6% overall increase Global sales of $3.9 billion for the first three months of 2025* are 5% up on the previous year’s first quarter. CEO perspective "Teva is a very different company than it was two years ago. We have sustainable growth. We have a world-class, late-stage pipeline. We have a good cash flow. We are moving from a world-class generics company to a world-class biopharma company enabled by generics." Richard Francis, Teva President and CEO Our Pivot to Growth strategy is clear Teva will continue to grow through 2027 driven by our innovative portfolio, drive a stable and cash-generating generics powerhouse and modernize the organization. We will accelerate growth beyond 2027 with our innovative pipeline. The four pillars of Pivot to Growth Pivot to Growth is not a tagline, it’s a detailed strategy built on four pillars: Deliver on growth engines and support patients with conditions including schizophrenia, migraine and involuntary movement disorders. Teva has accelerated its innovative portfolio to $2.3 billion, representing 30% core growth over the last two years. Read more: Deliver on Growth Engines Step up innovation by working on breakthrough treatments for diseases that are on the rise worldwide, such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), asthma and rheumatoid arthritis. The last two years have seen several new treatment launches and positive results for treatments in clinical trials at Teva. Read more: Step Up Innovation Sustain Teva’s position as a generics powerhouse and continue to provide affordable medicines globally. Teva’s generics business has grown by 5% across all regions since 2023. Read more: Generics Powerhouse and Access to Medicines Focus Teva’s business towards growth drivers by optimizing its portfolio and modernizing operations. Demonstrated by Teva’s transformation through its Pivot to Growth strategy. What comes next? Teva is a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by our world-class generics business to reliably deliver medicines to patients worldwide. With a robust late-stage pipeline and a sharpened focus on innovation and execution, we’ve entered the Acceleration Phase of our Pivot to Growth strategy. “The past two years have been about returning to growth and building a solid foundation. Today, Teva is a fundamentally different company, more focused, more innovative, and more robust. I am proud that we have consistently delivered on our commitments. Now, we are accelerating our growth into a leading biopharma company with a strong innovative medicines franchise and a powerhouse generics and biosimilars portfolio,” says Richard Francis. “We are scaling our growth engines, modernizing our operations, and unlocking long-term value across every part of the business. In every dimension - commercial, scientific, operational, and financial - we are executing with clarity and confidence.” Acceleration Phase priorities: Innovative portfolio: continues to drive strong performance and future potential, aiming to build a >$5 billion innovative medicines franchise by 2030 Late-stage pipeline: includes treatments for IBD, asthma, schizophrenia, multiple system atrophy (MSA) and celiac disease Biosimilars and OTC: a 13-strong biosimilars pipeline has the potential for 6 new launches by 2027, while a $1.1 billion OTC global business can achieve double-digit growth 2027 financial targets: reaffirmed targets include >$700 million in net savings and free cash flows of >$2.7 billion in 2027 and >$3.5 billion by 2030 Our strategy speaks to our Teva purpose – being all in for better health we work together to achieve remarkable things. Our direction is clear, and we are committed to keep raising the bar, in service of our patients, customers and healthcare systems. *All revenues in local currency terms NPS-ALL-NP-01710 FEBRUARY 2026 Read about the milestones on the journey Teva's Innovative Portfolio Fuels 10th Consecutive Quarter of Growth in Q2 2025 Teva Reports Ninth Consecutive Quarter of Growth in Q1 2025 Teva Delivers Second Consecutive Year of Growth 2024 Teva Announces Strong Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2024 Teva Announces Strong Growth in Second Quarter Revenues 2024 Teva Reports First Quarter 2024 Financial Results and Reaffirms 2024 Financial Outlook (tevapharm.com) Leading During Business Transformation: Richard Francis reflects on one year of Pivot to Growth at Teva Teva Reports Growth in Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 (tevapharm.com) Teva Reports Third Quarter 2023 Financial Results and Increases Revenue Guidance (tevapharm.com) Teva Reports Second Quarter 2023 Financial Results (tevapharm.com) Teva Launches New “Pivot to Growth” Strategy (tevapharm.com) Interested in getting involved in the work that we do? UNIPaaS Payments Technologies.title: Payments
UNIPaaS Payments Technologies.description: Embed Payments Solution for SaaS Platforms | Unipaas Embedded financial services Payments Our Payment Embed gives your users a unified, single solution to collect payments via their customers' preferred payment option online or via e-invoices. Make your users’ lives easier with one onboarding, one reporting, and one reconciliation. For all payment methods. If you have multiple payment partners, your users have extra headaches in terms of managing payment methods, reporting, and reconciliation in different places. With Unipaas Embed Payment, your users benefit from a single solution; one onboarding, one reporting interface, one place to manage cards, wallets, Direct Debit, and instant bank transfers, and one solution for reconciliation. Grow revenue with secure card payments Offering cards as a payment method is fundamental to your payments service, but it also needs to be supported in a secure way. ‍ Unipaas supports all major credit cards, including Visa , Mastercard , and American Express , providing a fully compliant and secure solution for seamless payment processing. Integrated with Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), our Payment Embed solution ensures secure transactions while maintaining smooth payment flows, reducing operational friction for your platform and delivering a smooth experience. Capture more revenue with wallets While cards are the incumbent payment method, wallet adoption has been skyrocketing in recent years. Unipaas Embed Payment keeps your platform ahead by offering a wide range of wallets and other payment methods, including Apple Pay and Google Pay . Streamline recurring payments with Direct Debit With many providers, setting up Direct Debit involves a lot of manual work. But if your users depend on recurring payments for their monthly memberships, service fees, or subscriptions, efficiency and automation are key. With our Payment Embed, you can start quickly, setting up mandate requests in days with no paperwork required. Because it is customisable and embedded into your platform, you maintain control over the experience and eliminate the need for third-party websites. And further, you receive real-time mandate and payment status updates, enabling you to proactively address any issues. Lower costs with instant bank transfers In many markets, consumers and businesses are looking at instant bank transfers with open banking as a low-cost, secure alternative to cards. With Unipaas Embed Payment, we offer instant bank transfers to enable direct, secure payments from bank accounts. This frictionless method reduces manual processes and offers immediate access to funds, streamlining the payment journey for platforms. It’s an ideal solution for businesses looking to optimise efficiency and reduce processing time. Learn more about how you can monetise payments with our effortless Subscriptions Embed. Tomorrow.io.title: DeepSky: The Early Warning Constellation, and The Five Instruments it Will Carry
Tomorrow.io.description: DeepSky: The Early Warning Constellation, and The Five Instruments it Will Carry DeepSky: The Early Warning Constellation, and The Five Instruments it Will Carry X Skip to content Weather is the most measured phenomenon on Earth, and for most of the planet the measurements were never taken. Over the oceans, across the tropics, throughout the un-radared world, the atmosphere goes hours unobserved — and those are the places where a late warning costs the most. DeepSky is the early warning constellation Tomorrow.io is building to close that gap: five instruments on one spacecraft, chosen so that each one sees what the others cannot. The record that was never kept Every forecast is downstream of a measurement somebody decided to take. A model learns from its training data; the data comes from an instrument; and the instrument exists because at some point a person decided that thing was worth measuring. For most of this planet, nobody ever made that decision. Roughly 71 percent of the Earth’s surface is ocean, and essentially none of it is covered by ground-based weather radar. Across much of Africa, South America and Asia there is little or none either. More than five billion people live outside radar coverage entirely. Over much of the world, on most days, nobody can say with confidence whether it rained yesterday. That is not a gap in the models. It is a gap in the record the models are built from — and a model cannot learn a sky that was never written down. Ocean, effectively unradared ~71% Share of Earth’s surface that is ocean, almost none of it covered by ground-based weather radar (1) People outside radar coverage 5B+ Tomorrow.io first-party estimate, derived from national radar-network coverage against population (2) Warning is the whole argument The gap is not evenly distributed, and neither is its cost. A storm that forms over open ocean is watched far less closely than one approaching a wealthy coastline. The events that most need to be seen coming are concentrated in exactly the places that are observed least. A hurricane deepens over water before anyone can measure how fast. A fire front moves further between satellite passes than the last picture suggested. A flood arrives in a valley where nobody measured the rain that fed it. A heat wave settles over a city without enough warning to open cooling centres. Surge and waves decide whether a coastline evacuates — and the wind driving them sits inside rain that most instruments cannot see through. The people with the least warning are the people with the most to lose. It is not a modeling problem. It is a gap in what humanity chose to measure. — Shimon Elkabetz , CEO and co-founder, Tomorrow.io Five ways to read one sky You cannot read the atmosphere in one wavelength. Different physics live in different parts of the spectrum, so the DeepSky suite is built to read across it — visible light, infrared, microwave and radio . Each band answers a question the others cannot. Gen-2 hyperspectral microwave sounders read temperature and moisture at many heights, straight through most cloud, day and night. This is the backbone of the starting picture: the observation class that carries the most weight in a global forecast, and the one that matters most over ocean and the un-radared world, where a forecast goes stale first. Because a sounder reads the whole column at once, where in that column a reading belongs is the thing it has to infer. GNSS radio occultation is the reference the rest of the fleet is trued against. A navigation signal grazing the edge of the atmosphere bends as it crosses, and the bend is the measurement — timed against an atomic clock rather than a calibration table. It is unaffected by cloud and needs no radiometric calibration of its own, which is what makes it usable as a standard rather than as one more satellite’s opinion. GNSS reflectometry reads surface wind inside a storm’s rain-wrapped core — the one place scatterometers and imagers go blind. Heavy rain scrambles a scatterometer’s return exactly where the dangerous winds live; imagers see the lid of cloud and nothing under it. Reflectometry reaches the winds that decide what a hurricane does to a coastline. Infrared and visible imaging reads cloud, surface and thermal state on every pass over a scene. It is also how thermal signatures are found and followed, which gives the constellation the ability to identify and monitor fire conditions — the same physics that maps a cloud top locates a fire front. Precipitation radar from space is active where the others are passive. It sends its own pulse and reads what returns, giving precipitation profiles at high resolution. Where a sounder reads how much water a column holds, the radar reads where in the column it sits, where it melts, and how tall the updraft built. That is the difference between a total and an anatomy. They don’t only cover each other. They calibrate each other. Flying several sensors together is table stakes; every serious observing system does it. The argument for this particular five is that each one’s blind spot is another one’s ordinary work . A hyperspectral microwave sounder’s radiances need a bias correction — a running model of the instrument’s own drift — before a forecast can safely use them, and that correction has to come from somewhere. Radio occultation supplies it, anchored to GPS timing rather than to another spacecraft’s calibration. The radar resolves the vertical structure a passive sounder can only infer. The imager adds the cloud and thermal picture the sounders do not carry. And the reflectometer reads the one condition that blinds the rest. This could be circular — each instrument confirming the others’ mistakes. It isn’t, because the web is pinned to things that do not drift: occultation is timed against an atomic clock, and radiosondes and ocean buoys are direct physical measurements taken independently of any satellite. The information Google collects, and how that information is used, depends on how you use our services and how you manage your privacy controls. Google also collects and uses data that is not associated with your account. We collect this information when a Google service on your device contacts our servers — for example, when you install an app from the Play Store or when a service checks for automatic updates. Build and integrate large pixel arrays with the surrounding analog circuitry, including bias circuits, row drivers, test structures, and other supporting blocks. Utila.title: News Utila Launches Licensed Partner Network for Fintechs
Utila.description: Utila Launches Licensed Partner Network for Fintechs Book a Demo Book a Demo Utila Launches Licensed Partner Network: An Industry-First, Direct Path to Compliant Stablecoin Payments for Fintechs Utila Launches Licensed Partner Network: An Industry-First, Direct Path to Compliant Stablecoin Payments for Fintechs Fipto, CoinGate, Balance, and Surus join an industry first network offering a regulatory umbrella for entities across the EU, Switzerland, US, and Canada on top of Utilaâs enterprise MPC wallet infrastructure. Fipto, CoinGate, Balance, and Surus join an industry first network offering a regulatory umbrella for entities across the EU, Switzerland, US, and Canada on top of Utilaâs enterprise MPC wallet infrastructure. Published on Sep 1, 2026 Read time 4 mins Share Summarize Utila, the institutional grade MPC wallet infrastructure provider for stablecoin payments and digital asset operations, today announced the launch of its Licensed Partner Network - an industry first program that lets fintechs and enterprises without their own money-transmission, e-money, or crypto-asset-service-provider licenses launch compliant stablecoin payment, custody, and payout products by plugging into a network of licensed partners, all through a single integration with Utila's platform. Fipto , CoinGate , Balance , and Surus are early participants in the network, collectively extending licensed coverage across the European Union, United States, and Canada. âLicensing has been the single biggest blocker between a fintech's stablecoin roadmap and a live product. With the Licensed Partner Network , we're removing that blocker - one integration into Utila gives clients access to a regulated, licensed rail across the EU, US, and Canada, giving them a fast and compliant path to market, which doesn't involve time and cost intensive licensing processes. This is just the start - we're actively adding partners and expect to extend the network into new regions over the coming months. Bentzi Rabi , Co-founder & CEO, Utila The Problem Most fintechs that want to offer stablecoin payments, payouts, or custody don't hold the licenses required to do so directly - an EU MiCA CASP authorization, US money transmitter licenses (MTLs) licensing, or regulated custodian status. Obtaining these licenses directly can take 12-24 months and requires significant capital. As a result, many companies that are otherwise ready to move forward and offer their clients stablecoin-based products remain on the sidelines. An Industry-First Solution Utila's Licensed Partner Network connects unlicensed clients to licensed partners who act as the regulated counterparty of record for custody, payments, or exchange activity. Utila provides the underlying MPC wallet infrastructure, policy engine, and compliance tooling that ties the experience together under a single technical integration. Clients get one platform and one integration; the network handles the regulatory perimeter behind it. It is the first network of its kind to combine licensed coverage across multiple markets with a unified wallet and operational infrastructure layer. Early Network Participants This initial phase of the network brings together regulated providers with complementary licenses, services, and geographic coverage. Through Utila, clients can connect with the partner suited to their target market and activity. The early network participants now include: Fipto (France/EU) Fipto is the modern infrastructure for B2B payments and treasury, powered by stablecoins. Fipto enables global companies to send, receive, and manage funds with near-instant settlement and 24/7 availability. By facilitating global money movement with regulated, programmable infrastructure, Fipto helps businesses optimize capital mobility and transparency. Fipto holds multiple licenses and regulatory approvals, including a Payment Institution license with the ACPR in France and a MiCA CASP license with the AMF in France. Fipto is available through API, web platform or Treasury Management Systems. Learn more about Fipto's payment solutions at www.fipto.com . CoinGate (EU, expanding to Switzerland) CoinGate is crypto payments infrastructure for business, serving companies, enterprises, and fintechs since 2014. CoinGate enables companies to accept crypto payments and run mass payouts with built-in FX, hold crypto and fiat in a single account, and settle in EUR, USD, GBP, or stablecoins. By pairing regulated custody and exchange with production-ready payment tools, CoinGate helps businesses access crypto payments quickly and with confidence. Learn more about CoinGate's business solutions at www.coingate.com . Balance (United States & Canada) Balance is Canadaâs oldest and largest digital asset custodian, a qualified U.S. and Canadian custodian through their subsidiary Balance Trust Company, and regulated U.S. money transmitter through their subsidiary Balance USA which is licensed across a majority of US states, providing custody and payout coverage in North America. Surus (United States) Surus is an onchain fiduciary whose wholly owned North Carolina-chartered trust company provides corporate trust services for institutions and fintechs. Surus services include qualified custody, tokenization, and fund administration as well as serving as a trustee and collateral agent for onchain products. Global Coverage Planned Utila plans to expand the network with additional licensed providers and geographic coverage over the coming months. This will give fintechs and enterprises a more consistent way to launch and scale stablecoin products across markets while working with an appropriately licensed counterparty in each jurisdiction. Companies interested in accessing the network or participating as a licensed partner can contact Utila at https://utila.io/contact . Vetric Technology.description: Vetric ALL JOBS Account Manager Sales Tel Aviv, Israel Description What is Vetric? Vetric builds large-scale public data infrastructure. We provide data pipelines that collect, structure, and deliver high-volume public web data for mission-critical companies operating in cybersecurity, public safety and digital risk protection. Our systems power platforms that detect bad actors, uncover impersonation and fraud, identify coordinated manipulation, and help public safety organizations respond faster to real-world risks. We don’t build dashboards, and we don’t sell surface-level insights. We build stable, production-grade data flows that become part of our customers’ core products, with the real impact of saving lives or huge known organizations from bad actors. Operating globally, we serve industry leaders across more than 20 countries who rely on us for scale, reliability, and depth. ﻿ Why Vetric? Vetric is profitable from day one (fully bootstrapped - we haven’t raised external funding), and we’re building foundational technology - not chasing trends. Because this is infrastructure that matters, we operate with engineering discipline, strong ownership, and long-term thinking. We’re at a true inflection point: the team is now large enough to require real infrastructure, yet still small enough that what you build will define how things work for the next several years. This is infrastructure that matters and so is how we operate internally. You’ll be working with a sharp, focused team that takes engineering discipline seriously and is intentionally building an organization that matches the quality of its product. Position Overview We’re looking for an Account Manager to own and grow relationships with Vetric’s existing customers and become a trusted partner in their long-term success. As an Account Manager, you’ll be responsible for a portfolio of strategic accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding how our customers use Vetric’s data infrastructure, and identifying opportunities to deepen and expand our partnerships. You’ll combine strong relationship management with a commercial mindset - ensuring customers see continued value while driving retention, renewals, and account growth. This role is ideal for someone who is proactive, customer-oriented, and commercially driven, with the ability to build trust, uncover opportunities, and navigate relationships across both business and technical stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Own and manage a portfolio of existing customers, serving as their primary commercial point of contact throughout the relationship. Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, needs, and strategic priorities. Drive customer retention and renewals by proactively managing account health, identifying risks, and ensuring customers continue to see strong value from Vetric. Identify and execute expansion opportunities within existing accounts, including upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Develop account plans and growth strategies for key customers, identifying new use cases, teams, and opportunities to expand the partnership. Lead commercial conversations, including renewals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and contract expansions. Work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Product, and other internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and address customer needs. Maintain accurate account information, opportunities, forecasts, and activities in the CRM. Consistently meet or exceed retention, renewal, and expansion targets and KPIs. Requirements 3+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success with commercial ownership, or a similar customer-facing role within a SaaS company. Proven experience managing and growing mid-size and enterprise accounts. Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated experience in renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion. Excellent relationship-building skills and the ability to develop trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to understand technical products and translate customer needs into meaningful business opportunities. Highly proactive and organized, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities independently. Experience with CRM platforms and account management tools. Fluent English, with native-level proficiency preferred. We’d be lucky if you had: Experience working with data infrastructure, APIs, cybersecurity, public safety, or digital risk protection solutions. Experience managing global enterprise customers, particularly in the US market. Experience working with technical stakeholders and complex, mission-critical products. B.A. degree in a relevant field. We hire people, not just skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this role is a great fit for you, even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements. ALL JOBS

Varonis Systems.title: giving back programs
Varonis Systems.description: Giving Back | Varonis 🤖 Say Hello to Agent Intent-Based Access Control in Varonis Atlas Learn more Giving Back Learn about our mission to unlock opportunity for hundreds of students. Contact Us Partner with a leader in data security. Forrester’s report states "Varonis is a top choice for organizations prioritizing deep data visibility, classification capabilities, and automated remediation for data access." We’d love for you to join us in our mission to unlock the potential of underprivileged kids through consistent, deliberate action. We want to share the details of a program that has worked well for us over the past four years and commit to helping you start your own program. So many kids are struggling, and the challenges of distance learning will only make things much worse. We believe c ompanies can help them develop the right tools and provide the necessary ongoing support to unlock their potential . Our program works because it’s so hands-on. By working closely with each student, we become part of each other’s lives. We com bine our immersive approach with what we’ve learned in our business about process, talent development, and accountability . The commitment is significant, but we cannot waste this untapped potential. Email giving@varonis.com to start the conversation with our team, or read on learn more about how our program works. Program Pillars Skills development Mindset and mentorship Accountability Life Skills Program High school students come to the Varonis HQ during the summer months, 2-3 days per week for a 5-week life skills program. They attend workshops with various teams and leaders at Varonis. The program focuses on practical life and business skills, and gives kids an understanding of what they might want to study in college or pursue as a career. Here is a breakdown of the workshops run by each team: Marketing/education – writing skills, event planning, digital marketing, creating an ad campaign HR/recruiting – resume and cover letter creation, interview role play, social media/LinkedIn networking, how to read a paystub, resources for job searching IT – basic computer skills, troubleshooting Sales – how to develop a sales pitch, shadowing sales meetings, pitching to the company Finance – personal finance, budgeting, saving & investing, opening a bank account, and how credit cards work Important to ensure success: Create consistency. Stick to the schedule and don’t cancel on your kids. A single point of contact. Designate one person to oversee the program and coordinate the volunteers, review content, and address ad hoc changes. Reminders, reminders, reminders! It takes time for the kids to develop strong habits; at the beginning, they will need reminders of the schedule and any prep work. Food! No one can think well when hungry, provide (healthy) food throughout the days. Listen. make sure you check in with them during the program, they are dealing with a lot and need someone to listen to them in order to be able to focus on the content of the session. Excel Skills Program Students learn basic excel skills through hands-on training with the Varonis finance team. The students and the team will meet for a total of 10 sessions over 5 weeks. Financial Skills Program Varonis CFO/COO, Guy Melamed, and members from the finance team meet with students for a 6-8 week comprehensive program. Students learn the fundamentals of finance and money management. Topics include: Credit cards, credit Scores, and budgeting Loans and ROI Compounding Interest Stock market education day NASDAQ visit day How to analyze risk SAT and Regents Prep Program The program provides extensive tutoring in math, English, and SAT prep. We’ve increased math scores on the New York Regents Exams by about 45% and SAT scores by 150 points. We found that the key is to p rovide tutoring in small groups and to measure scores before, during, and after to ensure they are getting the right amount of tutoring. Partner with one tutoring school, preferably one that can come onsite. After School Tutoring Program Research shows that high success in Math and English are indicators of financial success as adults; the earlier you build a strong foundation, the greater impact it has. Start with middle-schoolers. Partner with school principals to identify kids in need, and have a teacher/coach ensure the kids are showing up to class and tutoring sessions and actively participating. Measure grades before during and after to inspect progress. In our program, middle school students receive after school tutoring from a certified DOE-approved tutoring company that puts together a customized curriculum to help with Math, English, and NYS Exam prep. Internships Landing the first job is challenging, especially when you or your parents don’t have connections in the business world. What’s more, your first job can be a huge stepping stone to your career. Find a few areas in your organization that can onboard interns. It is important to partner with each intern with an internal “buddy” that can walk them through the company and job requirements. Alumni Support Program Alumni are students who have completely graduated from the Varonis program. Varonis conducts monthly check-ins with alumni and we host quarterly dinners to see how things have been, talk about changes going on in their life, provide ongoing support, help prep for interviews, compose college recommendation letters, etc. Staying connected builds the long-term trust, community, and friendship we all need as humans.

Verint Systems.description: Careers Privacy Policy | Verint Careers Privacy Policy VERINT Systems Inc. (“Company”) values your trust and is committed to the responsible management, use and protection of personal information. This Careers Site Privacy Policy (“Policy”) is applicable to all the information collected by VERINT from you during your use of our Careers site, located at www.verint.com careers section). Personal information submitted elsewhere on VERINT’s and its affiliate’s web sites will be used in accordance with our general online Privacy Policy (located at www.verint.com careers section). This Careers Site is operated by VERINT Systems Inc. (address: 225 Broadhollow Road, Suite 130 Melville, NY 11747) in order to support the recruitment functions VERINT Systems Inc. and its affiliated entities (collectively, “COMPANY”). Your Consent Please read this Policy carefully and indicate your acceptance of our collection, use, transfer and disclosure of personal information as described in this Policy by clicking the “I Accept” button at the end of the Policy. If you do not accept the terms you will not be provided access to apply for a position online. By agreeing to this Policy, you agree to the transfer of personal information about you to countries outside the country in which you reside, to countries with a different data protection regime than in place in the country in which you reside. VERINT will take appropriate technical, organizational, and legal steps to secure personal information about you. Information You Provide This Policy covers any personal information you submit through the Careers Site as part of the job application or job search process, including: name, contact information; CV, resume, cover letter, application, previous work experience and education information; employment preferences, willingness to relocate, current salary, desired salary and how you heard about the Careers Site; and professional and other work-related licenses, permits and certifications held; language and other relevant skills; awards and professional memberships; eligibility to work in country where job applied for is located, available start date; and information relating to reference You may also voluntarily choose to provide other relevant information as part of your application. We would prefer that you avoid submitting the following sensitive information, except where such information is legally required: sexual orientation, race, ethnic origin, religion, beliefs, disability, marital status, creed, nationality, national origin, color and/or age. If you intend to provide us with details of a reference or any other third party as part of your CV/résumé, it is your responsibility to obtain consent from that third party prior to passing the personal information to us. You are responsible for the content of the information you provide to us and you must ensure it is legal, truthful, accurate and not misleading in any way and does not infringe on any third party’s rights, or is not otherwise legally actionable by such third party. Use of Personal Information The information that you submit on the Careers Site will be stored in the United States (and in the relevant jurisdiction(s) if the job relates to one of VERINT’s affiliated entities outside of the United States). It will be reviewed and processed for the purposes below by employees, consultants and/or service providers of VERINT’s affiliates around the world. VERINT Systems Inc. will remain responsible for the personal information collected. Personal information you provide through the Careers Site will be collected, used, transferred and disclosed (“processed”) for VERINT’s global recruitment functions and for related management and planning purposes. VERINT will use the personal information you provide, as permitted by local law, to: process your application; assess your capabilities and qualifications for a job; conduct reference checks; provide to you any services available on the Careers Site from time to time; communicate with you; comply with any applicable law or regulation; monitor and record services whether provided by a VERINT company or a third party; and conduct background checks if you are offered a job. Personal information about you will be added to VERINT’s international candidate database and will be used for the purposes of considering whether your profile is suitable for other job vacancies at VERINT. If we elect to make you an offer, personal information you submit may be incorporated into our human resources system and used to manage the new-hire process. If you become an employee, any personal information that you submit may become part of your employee file and may be used for other employment/work-related purposes. The provision of personal information on the Careers Site is voluntary. Please note, failure to provide sufficient information, however, may result in VERINT being unable to consider your employment application or, if employment is offered, your subsequent promotion, transfer or relocation. Disclosure of Personal Information Personal information about you will be reviewed by VERINT employees or agents who have a business need to access such personal information and may include recruiters, human resources personnel, technical services personnel and managers or their designees. We may share personal information about you with selected service providers or consultants acting on our behalf, such as third parties assisting VERINT with the operation of the Careers Site. Those third parties will be required to protect personal information. Sustainability strategy At Verint, we aim to engage in business practices that reduce our environmental impact. As part of our environmental sustainability program: Nearly all of our product offerings are available in the cloud, which may reduce energy usage compared to traditional on-premises deployments. Our multi-tenant cloud offerings result in sharing computing resources among many customers, where we can achieve economies of scale, and may result in a reduction of energy consumption and carbon emissions. Nearly all of our product development and testing is done in the cloud. Some customers may experience lower energy consumption when migrating comparable workloads to our cloud-delivered solutions; impacts vary by configuration, utilization, and data center efficiency. In FYE 25, we completed our efforts to fully transition both our internal data centers and our external cloud operations to third-party cloud service providers, enabling us to leverage technology partners to provide best-in-class data center and cloud services at scale. We seek to reduce our carbon footprint by partnering with cloud service providers that have a commitment to reduction of carbon emissions or net-zero targets. For our deployments that are on-premises or hybrid, we typically fulfill the software electronically via download (as opposed to shipment of physical media). We have implemented a hybrid work model and have reduced our office footprint around the world, thereby reducing our office electrical consumption and emissions associated with employee commutes to and from Verint office locations. For our remaining offices, we strive to reduce energy consumption, such as through the use of motion sensor light switches, smart thermostats, and the configuration of computers and monitors to enter sleep mode when not in use. Our Hong Kong and India offices are also located in buildings that have green certifications under local standards. Embed security into the DevOps lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Infrastructure as Code), and software development workflows. Design and enforce security policies for cloud architecture, ensuring secure configurations and monitoring. Lead incident response activities, vulnerability management, and forensic investigations to mitigate threats. Drive compliance efforts (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, etc.) and audit readiness for the organization. Work closely with stakeholders (CISO, COO, System Architects, DevOps, IT, Finance, HR, etc’) to identify requirements and prioritize security needs. Continuously monitor systems and infrastructure for vulnerabilities, intrusions, and misconfiguration. Perform or manage penetration testing initiatives to identify security weaknesses. Requirements 5+ years of experience in sec-ops positions with relevant certifications Demonstrable experience working in IT, Networking, Infrastructure, DevOps environments Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and their security best practices(CSPM, ASPM, DSPM). Strong knowledge of cloud networking(VPC), firewalls, IAM roles, and encryption. Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and other security and regulatory frameworks, as part of GRC. Experience performing or overseeing penetration testing processes. Experience working with Forensic & Threat Detection Tools such as AWS GuardDuty, Azure Sentinel, Splunk, Qradar, Arcsight, and other SIEM systems Experience working with multiple EDR and XDR Tools (CS, SentinelOne, MS Defender, etc’) Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of explaining technical security concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to think critically and act decisively under pressure. Integration and project lead experience Team player Why UVeye: Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections. Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale. UVeye.title: Senior Deep Learning Engineer Tel-Aviv Full-time More Details Less Details
UVeye.description: Senior Deep Learning Engineer - UVeye Senior Deep Learning Engineer Tel-Aviv Full-time Departments: R&D - Algo Description At UVeye, we’re on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world’s first fully automated suite of AI-powered vehicle inspection systems, combining computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI. With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, JLR, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is deployed across manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, fleets, and seaports worldwide. Named one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies of 2026, our 300+ global employees are solutions-oriented, accountable, and driven by one shared goal: making roads safer for everyone. We are looking for an experienced Senior Deep Learning Engineer with proven capabilities to lead the development of state-of-the-art computer vision products from concept to production. In this role, you will be a part of a highly talented R&D team driving the core of UVeye’s inspection portfolio, while researching and implementing diverse Machine and Deep Learning algorithmic solutions to solve complex, real-world visual challenges. A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact: Design and Development of novel, robust and efficient Machine Learning/ Deep Learning algorithms for major Vision challenges. Create Proof of Concepts (PoC) for new products and technologies, transitioning research-grade ideas into scalable, production-ready systems. Evaluate, benchmark, and profile different algorithms on unique, large-scale proprietary datasets, while driving data-centric AI methodologies (active learning, data curation). Collaborate with infrastructure, MLOps, and hardware teams to define future technology, features, and optimize models for real-time inference constraints (on Edge/Cloud devices). Requirements 4+ years of industry experience in the development, optimization, and deployment of Deep Learning Algorithms in production environments. Hands-on industry experience working on major Vision problems in fields such as Detection, Classification, and Segmentation (experience with 3D Perception, Anomaly Detection, or Multi-View Geometry is a major advantage). Deep theoretical understanding of modern neural network architectures (e.g., CNNs, Vision Transformers – ViTs, Diffusion, or Generative AI for Vision) Experience with Python- Must, (C/C++ – An advantage). Experience with Major Deep Learning Frameworks (such as PyTorch, TensorFlow , etc.). Experience working with Tracking / Identification / Image Retrieval / Anomaly Detection / Pose Estimation / OCR/Image Registration -An advantage. Comfortable in unexplored territory, independent and self-motivated. M.Sc./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, or a related field – A strong advantage. Why UVeye: Pioneer Advanced Solutions: Harness cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, and computer vision to revolutionize vehicle inspections. Drive Global Impact: Your innovations will play a crucial role in enhancing automotive safety and reliability, impacting lives and businesses on an international scale.
